title: Registration language preference
benefit: Let registrants choose their preferred language at sign-up so their emails and notifications arrive in that language.
detail: A Language Preference system field was added to exhibitor and visitor registration forms, defaulting to the event language and supported in import and export. All emails and system notifications then use the chosen language.

title: Registration form field options
benefit: Build richer registration forms with website, state/region and city fields, and show the registrant’s category on the confirmation page.
detail: Custom text fields can be set as website fields that render as clickable links. Custom select fields can list states/regions or cities. Confirmation page scripts gain a category variable, showing “No category” when none was chosen.

title: Automatic meeting cancellation
benefit: Automatically cancel a participant's meetings and bookings when they become inactive or move to a category without meetings.
detail: Organisers can switch on automatic cancellation of confirmed, incoming and pending meetings, session bookings and exhibitor events when a participant's status is no longer active, and of meetings a user started when they move to a category that does not allow meetings, with the reason stated.

title: Meeting confirmation and location rules
benefit: Auto-confirm meetings for chosen participant categories and keep meeting locations accurate once the in-person event ends.
detail: Meeting auto-confirmation can be switched on per participant category. After the last in-person slot, requests offer only online meetings, and when 'other location' is allowed without preset options, requesters type the location themselves. Availability checks on the meeting schedule were also made faster.

title: Exhibitor events
benefit: Let exhibitors create their own events, which organisers approve and publish alongside the conference programme.
detail: Exhibitors create events from the frontend within organiser-set limits and durations; organisers approve or reject them, create events for exhibitors in admin and import them by XLS. Exhibitor events have their own Marketplace tab, booked-attendee lists, stand-restricted locations, invite links and an Events tab in My schedule.

title: Session filters and speaker display
benefit: Give attendees more ways to filter sessions and show speakers who have not yet activated their accounts.
detail: Tracks can be shown as a session filter, and up to five renamable standard filters can be configured per event. A toggle shows inactive, invited or uploaded speakers on the frontend, and attendees are taken straight to the online session room after signing in.

title: Chat and comments improvements
benefit: Reply to comments live in feeds and groups, and manage several chats at once on the web.
detail: Comments in Feed and Groups update live and support replies. Web chat windows can be minimised to a tab with unread badges, and exhibitors see their team members first when creating group chats.

title: Parent and child exhibitors
benefit: Parent exhibitors can manage their own child companies directly from the event website.
detail: A new 'My child exhibitors' page lets parent exhibitors search for, add or create child exhibitors. Organisers switch it on and set category rules, and new children receive login details by email, or automatically generated logins where single sign-on is used.

title: Exhibitor content limits
benefit: Set how much marketing content and news text each exhibitor category or exhibitor can publish.
detail: Organisers set marketing content limits per exhibitor, description length limits for marketing files and article length limits for news per category (0 for unlimited). Long descriptions expand with a More button, and uploads show a progress spinner.

title: Marketplace and profile improvements
benefit: Tailor how the marketplace, cards and category pickers behave for your event.
detail: Organisers set the default number of marketplace items per page, can show zip codes on exhibitor and product cards, and choose whether ticking a category also ticks its sub-categories. Brands with many products link to a full, paginated product list.

title: Sponsor banners and category-level sponsorship
benefit: Place sponsor banners on profile pages and set sponsorship for a whole exhibitor category at once.
detail: One or two rotating sponsor banners can appear on every My profile page, set per device. Exhibitor categories gain 'Is sponsor', 'Show in search list' and 'Show sponsor pop-up' toggles that apply to all their exhibitors, including through import and the API, without overwriting manual settings.

title: Sponsored sessions on exhibitor profiles
benefit: Show the sessions an exhibitor sponsors on its profile and let sponsors see who booked or attended them.
detail: Exhibitor profiles show a Sponsored sessions block automatically when the exhibitor sponsors sessions. The sponsor's dashboard adds 'Booked a session' and 'Attended session' columns covering online, onsite and on-demand attendance.

title: Interactive floor plans
benefit: Give attendees a new interactive floor plan on web and app, with exhibitor names on stands and one-click links from exhibitor cards.
detail: Admins draw and delete stands, show exhibitor names and stand labels that scale with zoom, hide stands or labels, and add sponsor banners at the top or side. Stand locations across the platform open the stand on the plan, the apps use the new floor plan, and hall and stand names are checked for duplicates on import.

title: Badge builder layout controls
benefit: Lay out printed badges precisely, with per-field alignment, margins, rotation, duplication and resizable codes.
detail: Every field in the badge builder, including QR codes, can be aligned left, centre or right, given left and right margins, rotated 180 degrees and duplicated; QR codes and barcodes can be resized and the category field moved. Badge links and codes can also be added to the category-switch registration email.

title: QR code PDF export
benefit: Export participants’ and exhibitors’ QR codes as a printable PDF, filtered by category and status.
detail: Organisers generate a PDF in the background with one large QR code per page alongside the holder’s details, including external codes.

title: Report column additions
benefit: Include exhibitor notes and session IDs in exports and reports.
detail: The Exhibitors export can include the notes from each exhibitor profile, and the favourited sessions report and its export show each session’s ID.

title: Event system content import
benefit: Pull exhibitors, sessions and speakers automatically from an external event management system.
detail: Exhibitors, sessions and speakers sync from the external system, configured per event, with exhibitors matched by account number and main contacts added as admin team members.

title: Passwordless login
benefit: Let attendees sign in with a one-time code sent by email instead of a password.
detail: Organisers switch on one-time password login per event. Users receive a code valid for three minutes with a short resend cooldown, the password reset window is hidden when codes are in use, and Android users can paste the code.

title: Participant email warnings
benefit: Spot participants with generated, missing or undeliverable email addresses directly in the admin panel.
detail: The participants list and meeting wizard mark accounts that use a generated placeholder email, have no email, or have an email domain that cannot receive mail, with the error named next to the warning.

title: Profile and page access improvements
benefit: Find options faster in profile select fields and control public page access with the sign-in setting.
detail: Country, city, region, nationality and custom select fields gain live search, including multi-select. Access to public file pages now follows the exhibitor sign-in access setting rather than the content preview toggle.

title: Website SEO and form tracking improvements
benefit: Event websites are easier for search engines to read, and form analytics record only genuine submissions.
detail: Every page now has an H1 heading, page markup errors reported by the W3C validator were fixed and internal links were optimised for search. Form tracking codes fire only after a form passes validation and submits successfully.

title: Default participant category
benefit: Every event now has a default participant category, so uncategorised participants always get sensible limits and settings.
detail: The default category is created with each event, cannot be deleted and has its own limits and settings. Participants without a category, or whose category is deleted, fall back to it.

title: Meeting and matchmaking card improvements
benefit: See who you are meeting and where at a glance, with clearer meeting cards and company names on matchmaking cards.
detail: Calendar meeting cards now show the other party and location first, then time and title. Matchmaking cards show the participant's company name. In the admin meeting management pages, participant photos and names link to their edit pages, and contact sharing settings are grouped into three labelled sections.

title: Meeting request improvements
benefit: Attach files to meeting requests, return to where you started after booking, and run the meetings grid in 20-minute steps.
detail: Requesters can attach a file to a meeting request in the app when organisers enable it. Users can be returned to the page where they started a request, keeping filters and pagination. A 20-minute time step was added to the meetings grid, with matching maximum meeting lengths.

title: Meeting rescheduling controls
benefit: Reschedule meetings faster from the existing slot, and hide rescheduling for chosen roles and categories on web and app.
detail: The rescheduling time grid now opens on the meeting's current date with its time preselected. A 'Disallow meeting reschedule for' setting hides the Reschedule button on meeting cards for selected roles and categories, on web and in the app.

title: Schedule blocking for speakers
benefit: Stop meetings from being booked over speakers' and moderators' sessions, and keep blocking events from clashing with confirmed meetings.
detail: Speakers' and moderators' calendars are blocked during their sessions and exhibitor events for meeting requests and confirmations. Slot-blocking exhibitor events can no longer be booked over confirmed meetings, blocked time, other blocking events or speaker duties.

title: Exhibitor event editing controls
benefit: Lock approved exhibitor events against changes and give organisers clearer status and import options.
detail: A session-type toggle stops exhibitors editing or deleting events once approved, while organisers can still edit them. Ended events show a Past status, imports accept child exhibitor and contact IDs, and events are checked against session-type and stand hours.

title: Exhibitor events in the app
benefit: Let app users browse all exhibitor events, add them to their schedule and see the ones they have booked.
detail: The iOS and Android apps gain an all exhibitor events list with date switching and filters, and a My exhibitor events page listing booked events, with a Download My Schedule button to save the schedule as a PDF.

title: Session import and schedule download
benefit: Import and export session filters in bulk and download a personal schedule from a clearly named button.
detail: The five session filters are included in the sessions XLS import and export. The Export data button on My Schedule and Team Schedule becomes Download My Schedule, and session loading was sped up with additional database indexes.

title: Multilingual marketing emails
benefit: Send marketing emails in each recipient’s chosen language.
detail: Email sender and campaign templates can be written per language, and recipients receive the version in their selected language, falling back to the default language.

title: Exhibitor setup improvements
benefit: Give uncategorised exhibitors sensible defaults and control product limits and manual navigation.
detail: Each new event gets a Default exhibitor category whose settings and limits apply to uncategorised exhibitors. Organisers can block adding products once the active-product limit is reached and set the default products tab, and each exhibitor manual link now opens its own section.

title: Faster marketplace and product imports
benefit: Marketplace pages load faster and product imports update search more efficiently.
detail: Duplicate queries were removed from the marketplace page, and product search indexing now runs once at the end of an import and only for fields that changed.

title: Lead scanning across co-located events
benefit: Scan the badges of attendees from co-located events and jump straight to their profiles.
detail: With a new contact-sharing setting on, the app saves scans from other events in the same database with an 'other event' label, and scan reports gain an event name column. After a scan, tapping a person's name or a team member's company opens their profile.

title: Leads from meetings and exhibitor events
benefit: Turn exhibitor event bookings and meetings of any status into leads.
detail: Exhibitors holding their own events see bookings in the Interactions dashboard and, if enabled, as leads in Download leads, with private details optionally hidden. A new setting includes pending, incoming, confirmed and cancelled meetings in leads files without duplicates.

title: Rich text for profiles and news
benefit: Format company descriptions and news articles with headings, lists, images and links.
detail: The full text editor is available for 'About the company' in the exhibitor profile editor and for exhibitor news, with headings, bold, italic, underline, lists, alignment, quotes, photos and links.

title: Sponsor banner and card layout
benefit: Sponsor banners and cards display cleanly on tablets and phones.
detail: On smaller screens, marketplace sponsor banners and the product finder sit in a compact block above the filters, and sponsor and sponsored product cards are laid out six in a row.

title: External QR and barcode scanning
benefit: Scan external QR codes, barcodes and co-located event badges at check-in, in the app and at kiosks.
detail: Unknown codes are saved rather than rejected, and the check-in list report shows each scanned code and, where recognised, its event. An optional setting lets the mobile app scan and store any code, and kiosks check in participants whose external codes came from an integration or the API.

title: ExpoFP floor plan linking
benefit: Send attendees from any stand link on web or app straight to the right stand on an ExpoFP floor plan.
detail: Organisers choose dynamic linking, a static URL or no link. Stand links on marketplace, exhibitor, product, session, exhibitor event, schedule and recommendation pages, and on app profiles and lists, follow the setting.

title: Kiosk check-in improvements
benefit: Help visitors find themselves and register faster at self-service kiosks.
detail: Kiosk search by name or email now returns every matching participant, loaded in batches. The kiosk registration form supports the same conditional logic as the web registration form builder.

title: US English and wording updates
benefit: Offer the app in US English and use clearer wording on public profiles.
detail: The apps pick US English from the phone’s locale, with US spellings such as “Favorites”. The “Matchmaking information” section on public profiles is now called “Profile Information”, and the Android app’s network security settings were tightened.

title: New analytics
benefit: Track registrations, content performance and activity in a new analytics dashboard.
detail: Dashboard widgets show participants, exhibitors, content and actions, plus online participants by country and interest. Registration widgets break down sign-ups over time by category, country and interest, and content widgets cover news, sessions, on-demand, webinars and downloads. Pages open on a range a month either side of the event.

title: Export progress and cancellation
benefit: Follow the progress of exports and cancel them when needed.
detail: Exports show a percentage progress indicator and a cancel button, and a clear status while the file is being generated. The check-in export runs faster.

title: Mobile app analytics
benefit: See how attendees use the mobile app, including logins and unique users per app.
detail: A mobile app logins report lists each login on iOS and Android with profile fields, supporting unique login counts. An App data tab in analytics shows page views, unique badge scans and unique logins per platform.

title: Visit badge and scanner integration
benefit: Use Visit digital badges and the Visit lead scanner inside the platform, with scanned leads pulled back in.
detail: Organisers can switch on the external Visit badge and lead scanner for web and app, sync leads scanned in Visit into the platform, and choose email or external ID as the matching identifier.

title: Meeting data in the public API
benefit: Retrieve full meeting data through the public API, including incremental updates since your last sync.
detail: A paginated endpoint returns every meeting with the same fields as the meetings export, with filters by account and time and sort options. Session responses include the exhibitor ID for exhibitor events, updating an exhibitor's hall and stand also moves their pre-scheduled meetings, and the account interactions endpoint was documented.

title: Full module management
benefit: Switch every admin panel section and sub-section on or off to match each event.
detail: Global and event module management were restructured so every admin menu tab and sub-tab can be toggled, including a separate networking and matchmaking section. Analytics tabs redirect correctly when a module is turned off.

title: Admin action log
benefit: Search, filter and export a full history of actions taken in the admin panel.
detail: A new admin action log offers event, date, controller and action filters, search within request content and XLS export, and records newer admin panel actions.

title: Arabic language option
benefit: Offer Arabic as a platform language for your event.
detail: Arabic is available as a platform language, shown as AR in the language list.

title: Assigned admins for accounts
benefit: Assign a responsible admin to each exhibitor or participant and filter lists by them.
detail: The admin exhibitor and participant lists gain an assigned admin column, an assignment pop-up, and filtering and sorting by assigned admin.

title: Clearer admin panel settings
benefit: Understand admin settings more easily with clearer names, tooltips and introductory text.
detail: Several confusing settings were renamed, tooltips were added across admin modules, selected pages show a short intro explaining their purpose, and fields with errors are highlighted in exhibitor category settings.

title: Easier account activation
benefit: Help users with inactive accounts activate them straight from the login screen on web and app.
detail: Inactive users see one clear activation message across web and the iOS and Android apps, with a resend activation link action, including for one-time password login. The activation notice takes priority over a wrong-password error.

title: Faster search indexing and listings
benefit: Get search results and marketplace listings up to date and loading faster.
detail: Search indexing after event cloning and for whole events now runs in bulk, exhibitor list requests on the marketplace page were reorganised, and additional database indexes were added.

title: Spam protection for exhibitor sign-up
benefit: Protect exhibitor registration from spam submissions.
detail: Frontend exhibitor registration includes a mandatory reCAPTCHA step.

title: New website builder
benefit: Build event websites in a new visual builder with site-wide styling, custom headers and footers, and mobile-ready pages.
detail: A main menu gives access to blocks, pages, device previews, languages, history, global settings, save and publish. Global settings cover fonts (including uploaded fonts), colours, buttons, favicon and SEO; the header and footer include logo, navigation, search and calls to action. Each event can switch between the old and new builders.

title: Events page improvements
benefit: Visitors see clearer event dates and a tidier filter bar on the events listing.
detail: Event date ranges use compact formats for events within one month, across two months or across two years. The filter reset button appears only when filters are applied.

title: Category and form setup improvements
benefit: Control the order participant categories appear in, and avoid duplicate answer options in custom questions.
detail: Participant categories can be reordered by drag and drop or sorted A–Z/Z–A, and that order is used in frontend filters, registration, booking, admin profiles and the app. Custom questions no longer accept answer options with the same name.

title: Blocked time management
benefit: Manage blocked time directly from your schedule, and let exhibitors block time for their team members.
detail: Blocked time is now a schedule item with its own cards and edit and delete actions, managed from the Schedule and Team Schedule pages through an 'Add blocked time' pop-up. Exhibitor companies can set blocked time for team members, and blocked time can apply to exhibitor events only. Allowance settings gained explanatory tooltips.

title: Calendar sync improvements
benefit: Get clearer meeting details in synced Outlook and Google Calendar entries.
detail: Synced Outlook meeting entries include a structured block with companies, participants, title and message. A Google Calendar option excludes attendee emails and puts participant names in the event description instead, matching the Outlook behaviour.

title: Hosted buyer team setup
benefit: Bring exhibitor team members into a hosted buyer programme with a single approval and the right category automatically.
detail: For private events with public registration, buyer-category team members need only one hosted buyer acceptance. A default category setting assigns a buyer category to team members that exhibitors create themselves.

title: Meeting completion by badge scan
benefit: Mark confirmed meetings as completed simply by scanning the other participant's badge, with completion visible in exports and the API.
detail: Badge-scan auto-completion covers regular meetings, with an option to complete meetings scanned outside the meeting time. Completion appears in exports and the API. A scan by any of an exhibitor's team members completes meetings the exhibitor joined before adding team members.

title: Meeting ratings
benefit: Ask attendees to rate their meetings after each meeting, daily or after the event, by email, WhatsApp or SMS.
detail: Organisers choose when ratings are requested for each role or category. Digest emails list meetings to rate and link straight to the ratings page or the app, and the email template is now named 'Meeting Ratings'.

title: New meeting request flow
benefit: Book a meeting on a single page that shows both sides' live availability for date, time, location and duration.
detail: An optional new meeting request flow brings participants, date, time, location and duration onto one page. Users see all bookable dates for both sides, each choice updates the remaining options, and clear error messages explain what needs fixing.

title: New schedule calendar view
benefit: See your schedule in a calendar view that separates committed meetings from optional activities, on web and in the app.
detail: Schedule pages are split into Diary and Optional Activities, with team member selection, activity filters and a legend. The app gained a matching calendar view for My Schedule and Team Schedule. Organisers set the default view and items shown, and a new time picker shows unavailable slots.

title: Reassign team members to meetings
benefit: Let exhibitors swap which team member attends a meeting, including across child companies.
detail: When enabled, a Reassign members button on exhibitor meeting cards opens a pop-up to choose another available team member for the meeting.

title: Schedule downloads in Excel and app
benefit: Download your schedule as an Excel file, including team and child company details, or have it emailed from the app.
detail: Participants can choose PDF or XLS schedule downloads, with team and parent/child company columns for exhibitors. App users can request their schedule and receive it by email as an attachment. Downloaded files now include personal blocked time.

title: User favourites dashboard
benefit: See every participant's favourites with meeting status and notes, and start meetings from them as an organiser.
detail: A favourites dashboard in Networking & Matchmaking lists each favourite with its meeting status, notes and the admin who shared it, and shared filter links now record who shared them.

title: Session and speaker management improvements
benefit: Avoid double-booking speakers, control anonymous questions and give speakers their own menu page.
detail: Speakers and moderators with blocked time can no longer be assigned to clashing sessions unless organisers allow it. Organisers can hide the Ask anonymously option in session rooms, speakers get a separate menu item, and the apps show the price on past paid sessions.

title: Email nurturing content blocks
benefit: Add personalised recommendations, meetings, messages and activity to campaign emails.
detail: Campaign email variables show recommended exhibitors, products, sessions and news as cards with meeting, message and favourite actions, plus incoming meetings, unanswered chats and live activity counts. A profile link variable signs recipients in, and templates were rolled out to all events.

title: Messenger improvements
benefit: Filter chats by who started them and by meeting status, and chat comfortably on mobile web.
detail: Messenger gains filters for who initiated a chat and for meeting status. On mobile web, private chat has a back-to-list button and a fixed header and input.

title: Segmented push notifications
benefit: Target admin notifications by profile attributes or by what attendees have in their schedule.
detail: Organisers send notifications to users matching advanced profile filters, or who have scheduled a particular session, exhibitor event, type, track or tag.

title: Custom lead capture questions
benefit: Exhibitors add their own questions to the lead capture form so their team records what matters to them.
detail: Exhibitor admins create custom lead questions for their team members, with text, select, multiselect, radio and checkbox types, and answers appear in the leads report. Organisers can open an exhibitor's questions from its admin profile, and duplicate scans are filtered out.

title: Custom table listings
benefit: Show exhibitors and delegates as a configurable table of the fields you choose.
detail: An optional table view for the exhibitor and delegate lists, with an admin builder for choosing and ordering fields. Tables use event branding, show full names on hover and open a pop-up with all of an exhibitor's categories.

title: Dedicated sponsor section in the marketplace
benefit: Sponsors get their own highlighted section above exhibitors on the web and in the app.
detail: Sponsors appear in a separate framed section of cards above the exhibitor list, as an auto-scrolling carousel or static rows. The app gains a sponsors block on exhibitor and product lists, and clicks now count in sponsor statistics.

title: Exhibitor overview report
benefit: Exhibitors download one report covering their company and all child companies.
detail: An Exhibitor Overview spreadsheet in the profile menu lists views, products, content, chats, meetings and badge scans for the exhibitor and each child exhibitor across the event.

title: Team member interaction controls
benefit: Exhibitors decide which team members can take meetings and chat, on the web and in the app.
detail: Exhibitors, and optionally parent exhibitors, switch meetings and chats on or off per team member. The app hides blocked actions and explains why, and the settings are included in the team members export and the public API.

title: Badge scanning on more Android devices
benefit: Scan badges in the Android app on devices without Google Play services, such as Huawei phones.
detail: The Android app uses an alternative barcode scanner on devices that lack Google Play services, so badge scanning works on them too.

title: Live location on ExpoFP floor plans
benefit: Show app users their own position as a blue dot on ExpoFP floor plans, powered by Crowd Connected.
detail: The mobile apps use Crowd Connected as the location provider for ExpoFP floor plans, with foreground, background and reminder permission prompts.

title: Redesigned Android lists and sessions
benefit: Browse people, exhibitors, products, brands and sessions in a refreshed Android app design, matching iOS.
detail: Delegate, buyer, exhibitor, product and brand lists, and session cards and pages, were redesigned, with a Live tag, prices and a book button for paid sessions, plus a new no-results screen. Icons across the app follow one consistent style and size.

title: Custom check-in reports
benefit: Export check-in reports with the columns you choose and see first-time versus repeat scans.
detail: Organisers pick system and custom fields for the check-in report and can export unique check-ins per event or per day, including co-located show badges and external codes, with the scanned code shown.

title: Dashboard improvements
benefit: Load the favourites dashboard faster and keep table headers in view.
detail: The favourites dashboard uses pre-calculated data refreshed every 30 minutes, with an Update button and last-update time. The interactions table header in visitor and exhibitor dashboards stays fixed while scrolling.

title: Global search
benefit: Search the event from one place, with results ranked by weighted relevance across exhibitors, products and brands.
detail: A new search engine scores matches using admin-set multipliers and category weights, supports prefix and fuzzy matching, shows result counters and lets delegates, buyers and speakers be found by activity category.

title: ExpoFP floor plan integration
benefit: Show the interactive ExpoFP floor plan on the event site, with search, deep links and wayfinding.
detail: Enabled with an account token, the ExpoFP floor plan lets attendees search exhibitors, custom locations and sessions, including in-person sessions and exhibitor events with a physical location.

title: Reach5 login for buyer registration
benefit: Let returning buyers log in with their Reach5 account in the buyer registration pop-up.
detail: Reach5 login was added to the buyer registration pop-up used on the repeat-registration link.

title: Multi-factor authentication for admins
benefit: Require admins to sign in with a password plus an authenticator app code.
detail: Admin accounts gain an MFA tab to enable authenticator-app login, exclude chosen admins and send MFA setup emails.

title: Smoother SSO sign-in
benefit: Let SAML single sign-on users sign in within the same tab and see a custom error page if they are not registered.
detail: The web login pop-up for SAML SSO is replaced by in-tab sign-in that returns users to where they started. Organisers can design a website page to show SSO users who are not found on the event.

title: Content and dynamic blocks
benefit: Add ready-made blocks that show exhibitors, products, brands, sponsors, speakers, sessions and news straight from event data.
detail: A library of static content blocks covers text, media, cards, testimonials, countdown, app download and FAQ. Dynamic blocks display as sliders or static grids, with filters such as category, tag or specific items, plus sorting, cards per row and style settings.

title: Attendee widget and X branding
benefit: Show a rotating set of attendees on the website, and see the updated X logo and name wherever social links appear.
detail: An attendee widget shows a rotating set of attendee cards without interaction buttons. The Twitter logo and name were updated to X in the email builder, registration pages, profiles and exhibitor services.

title: Media gallery and builder switch
benefit: Store and organise website images, videos and files in one gallery, and turn the new builder on per event.
detail: The gallery supports uploads, nested folders, sorting, gallery and list views, video conversion, and renaming, previewing and moving files. A module setting and an event setting control when the new builder is used.

title: UTM tracking on confirmation pages
benefit: Attribute registrations to campaigns in Google Analytics, as UTM codes now carry through to the confirmation page.
detail: UTM parameters from the registration URL are passed through to the registration confirmation page, so registrations can be attributed in Google Analytics.

title: Schedule and meeting limit improvements
benefit: Move through event dates more easily and get clearer agenda exports and meeting limit settings.
detail: The Schedule page date selector shows all relevant dates with back and forward arrows. The agenda PDF can include the event logo and date headings. Exhibitor category meeting limits no longer treat zero as unlimited, and delegate page custom filters no longer offer an 'other' option.

title: Native exhibitor events in the app
benefit: Browse, search and filter exhibitor events in a native app page that follows the same rules as the web.
detail: A native page with Exhibitor Events and On-demand tabs replaces the web view. The apps honour slot blocking, non-removable events, visibility, tracks and speaker, moderator and sponsor display, and moderators are marked with an icon in profiles, lists and sessions.

title: Multilingual exhibitor events
benefit: Publish exhibitor event names and descriptions in several languages on the web and in the app.
detail: A language switcher lets users read exhibitor events in any supported language, defaulting to the language set by the organiser, with translated event names and descriptions.

title: Campaigns refresh
benefit: Manage email campaigns in a redesigned area with duplication, warnings and clearer statistics.
detail: The campaigns list and campaign page were redesigned with filters, empty states and statistics. Organisers can duplicate campaigns, are warned about unsaved changes or empty templates, and export data only appears once a campaign has been sent.

title: Message limit setting
benefit: Set how many messages participants can send.
detail: Organisers can configure a limit on the number of messages.

title: Exhibitor manual translation
benefit: Publish the exhibitor manual in every language your event supports.
detail: Every exhibitor manual section, including section names, can be switched between platform languages and translated in the admin panel, as already possible for registration.

title: Sponsor management improvements
benefit: Find sponsors quickly in the admin panel and let visitors act on sponsor cards.
detail: Admins search sponsors and filter them by sponsor category. Sponsor and sponsored product cards on the marketplace show location and meeting and message buttons on hover, and these interactions count in sponsor reports.

title: Floor plan improvements
benefit: Navigate the floor plan more easily, with a smoother view, clearer filters and direct links to sessions.
detail: The floor plan view was rebuilt and improved; unneeded hall arrows are hidden for single-hall events; the Visited quick filter lists visited stands; quick filters show a no-results message; and sessions or events on a stand open their public profile.

title: Arabic app and multilingual pages
benefit: Offer the mobile app in Arabic and open in-app pages in the user’s app language.
detail: The mobile app was translated into Arabic. Edit profile, floor plan, basket, exhibitor events and delegates pages open in the app language when the event supports it, otherwise in English.

title: Login source in login reports
benefit: See whether each login came from the web or the iOS or Android app.
detail: The visitor and exhibitor login report export has a login source column for every login attempt.

title: Search refinements and new search bar
benefit: Find content faster with a simpler search bar and more accurate ranking for products, brands, sessions and exhibitor events.
detail: A single redesigned search bar now appears on the marketplace, sessions, delegates, news, groups and floor plan pages. Country is indexed for products and brands, speaker names and exhibitors boost session and exhibitor event results, stop-words are ignored and permission rules filter the delegate list.

title: Klipso integration
benefit: Import exhibitors from Klipso automatically, with categories and custom questions kept up to date.
detail: The integration pulls exhibitor data from Klipso every minute or on demand with a Sync button, maps categories by text, brings in chosen exhibitor custom questions and passes contact email and username.

title: Public API improvements
benefit: Do more through the public API, from exporting buyers to creating products with image links.
detail: A buyers-only export is available through the API, product images can be sent as URLs, session responses include speakers and moderators, exhibitor event 'Other' locations can be set, the indoor maps toggle is exposed and activity category limits can be set when editing profiles.

title: Aligned module and permission settings
benefit: Keep meeting and messaging permissions consistent with the modules switched on for an event.
detail: The relationship between module management and the permission matrix for meetings and messages was improved.

title: Faster floor plans and filters
benefit: Load integrated floor plans and filters more quickly.
detail: Integrated floor plans are cached and optimised, and the filters service was optimised.

title: Loading indicators on listings
benefit: See clear loading feedback while listing pages and session dates load.
detail: Listing pages show loaders while content loads, and the sessions page shows a loader when switching to another date.

title: Login by badge scan
benefit: Let app users sign in by scanning their event badge.
detail: Badge-scan login in the mobile app can be switched on per event, limited to chosen categories and shown with a configurable login button. It works with one-time password login and activates the account.

title: Self-service account deletion
benefit: Let users choose events and request deletion of their account data from one page.
detail: A single event selection page lists the events a verified user belongs to, so they can select events and delete their account and data.

title: Simpler one-time password login
benefit: Let users request a one-time login code whatever their account status.
detail: A one-time code is emailed on request regardless of account status, and inactive users become active once they log in. On public events any user can request a code by email and sign in.

title: Browser language and consent mode
benefit: Websites open in the visitor's browser language when available, with support for cookie consent mode.
detail: The language selector defaults to the visitor's browser language when the site supports it, and visitors can still switch manually. Consent mode support was added for cookie consent.

title: Rich content and text editing
benefit: Build free-form page sections with a full text editor, title blocks and custom HTML that can run scripts.
detail: A Custom Content block offers backgrounds, overlays and a rich-text editor with tables, columns, images and YouTube. Text modules gain a WYSIWYG editor, a Title & Subtitle block comes in six layouts, and custom HTML blocks can run JavaScript.

title: Category cloning
benefit: Duplicate participant and exhibitor categories with all their settings, then change only what differs.
detail: A Duplicate button copies a category with all its settings as a named copy. The categories table is also adaptive and supports drag-and-drop ordering.

title: Print badge link on confirmation page
benefit: Let visitors print their badge straight from the registration confirmation page.
detail: A Print Your Badge variable can be added to the visitor confirmation page; the link opens the visitor’s badge in a new tab, matching the print option in the profile and admin panel.

title: Prefilled meeting requests
benefit: Save a default subject, message, duration and file once and have them pre-filled in every new meeting request.
detail: In the new web meeting request flow, users save default meeting information from a pop-up or their profile settings, and can still edit it on each request.

title: Meeting availability filter
benefit: Let buyers filter lists to show only exhibitors and people who still have meetings available.
detail: A 'Meeting availability' filter can be added to exhibitor, product, pavilion, speaker, delegate and buyer lists through display filters, with an explanatory tooltip in the admin panel.

title: Minimum meeting reminders
benefit: Set a minimum number of confirmed meetings per category and remind participants who have not reached it.
detail: Organisers set a required number of confirmed meetings per category. Users see confirmed versus required meetings on their meetings page and receive automated reminder emails until they reach it.

title: Other locations for sessions and events
benefit: Place sessions and exhibitor events at venues outside the floor plan, with addresses shown on web and app cards.
detail: Organisers manage a predefined list of other locations for sessions and exhibitor events, can allow a custom alternative location, and can add an address that appears on session cards, in the API and in export and import. The iOS and Android apps show the address on cards.

title: Schedule and invite link improvements
benefit: Stop attendees adding items that clash with blocked time and show times in event time only if preferred.
detail: Direct invite links for meetings, sessions and exhibitor events add the item and open the schedule, or name the clashing item. A setting hides local time on web and app, session speakers and moderators can be added to exhibitor events, and app session pages gain loading and not-found states.

title: Badge codes in emails
benefit: Include each recipient’s badge barcode and QR code in campaign and buyer emails.
detail: Badge barcode and QR code variables are available in campaign emails and in the buyer acceptance email, showing internal or external badge codes that the check-in app can scan.

title: Company and job title on cards
benefit: See who people are at a glance, with company and job title on user cards across web and app.
detail: Participant cards in community, team members, meetings, messenger, profiles and sessions show company name and job title on the web and in the mobile app.

title: Leads and sponsor export improvements
benefit: Leads and sponsor exports carry more context about each interaction.
detail: Leads exports add exhibitor event date and time and, if enabled, meeting rating notes. The exhibitor export's custom field list was updated, and sponsor statistics exports use a clearer layout and count only sponsors actually shown on screen.

title: Meeting locations on the floor plan
benefit: Tap a meeting’s location in the app to open the floor plan at that spot.
detail: Meeting cards in the app make the location clickable in any meeting status, opening internal, MapsPeople or ExpoFP floor plans focused on the meeting place.

title: In-app updates
benefit: Prompt attendees to update the app when a newer version is available.
detail: Organisers enable in-app updates in the app builder and choose required or optional update prompts, which the apps show when a new version is released.

title: Check-in analytics refresh
benefit: Follow check-ins and check-outs by day, hour and zone in redesigned check-in analytics.
detail: A new analytics page charts registrations before and after the event starts and check-ins and check-outs by day or hour, with user and zone filters. The check-in list shows each participant’s first and last check-in and check-out per day, and the zones page manages zones synced with the floor plan.

title: Mobile analytics page
benefit: Chart mobile app logins, page views, favourites, meetings and badge scans over time.
detail: The mobile analytics page shows daily, weekly or monthly graphs, filtered by user group, platform and page.

title: Meetings analytics
benefit: Analyse meeting activity across web and app in the new analytics module.
detail: A Meetings tab with event, segment and date filters shows requested meetings by status, online and offline counts, average meeting length and time spent in online meetings.

title: Standard report
benefit: Generate a standard event report from the admin Data page.
detail: Admins generate the standard report from the Data page in the same way as other reports.

title: AI assistant in the admin panel
benefit: Ask an AI assistant questions about the platform from any admin page and get answers drawn from the documentation.
detail: A chat assistant based on a large language model opens from an icon on every admin page, keeps conversation history and collects feedback on answers. Access is controlled per client, and the icon can be dragged out of the way.

title: Global search across all content
benefit: Search exhibitor events, sessions, on-demand content, news, groups, delegates, speakers and buyers with the same ranked search.
detail: The search engine now covers every main section with section-specific multipliers and filters, is on by default for new events and matches exhibitor names on exhibitor events. Search results in the Android app also update more reliably.

title: Recommendation display improvements
benefit: Control how personalised recommendations are shown on the session overview and in the Android app.
detail: A new setting decides whether session recommendations are expanded when the session overview loads, and the logic behind the recommended sections in the Android app was improved.

title: Admin workflow improvements
benefit: Open a user’s profile as them, keep list filters between visits and find session settings faster.
detail: A customer service action in the exhibitor and visitor lists logs an admin in as that user in a new tab. Filters and search persist per admin on sponsor, participant, exhibitor and session lists, and the sessions configuration page is regrouped by area.

title: Event-time-only display
benefit: Choose to show only event time, without local time, across the web and app.
detail: When the setting is on, meetings, sessions, exhibitor events and blocked times show only event time on every frontend page.

title: More reliable exports
benefit: Download exports that recover automatically from temporary glitches instead of hanging.
detail: Exports run on a status-controlled process that reruns an incompletely processed batch up to three times, and the exhibitor manual export runs as a queued job with all details included in the file.

title: Security hardening across web and apps
benefit: Benefit from fixes to security findings across the website, admin panel, server and mobile apps.
detail: Issues identified in a security assessment were fixed in the frontend, admin panel and server, and in the Android and iOS apps.

title: Multilingual websites
benefit: Run the same website in several languages, keeping page structure in sync while translating the text of each version.
detail: Blocks are shared across language versions with independent text by default; organisers can desync a language and later restore it. Favourite blocks and an extra blocks section make frequently used content quicker to add.

title: Website builder editing controls
benefit: Control autosave, video autoplay and special link types while building pages.
detail: Autosave in the builder can be turned off, every video block has an autoplay setting, and links in blocks support special link types.

title: Discount, invoice and basket improvements
benefit: Apply discounts more reliably, pay by invoice with updated logic and add sessions to the basket from a direct link.
detail: Discount application was improved, the invoice payment logic was updated, and sessions gained an “add to basket” link so attendees can place them in their basket directly.

title: Registration field timestamps
benefit: Record when a registrant filled in a specific form field and see it in the export.
detail: Any registration field can be flagged to record the time of input. The latest input time before registration completes is stored in event local time and exported as a column next to the field.

title: Meeting limits with auto-confirmation
benefit: Keep auto-confirmed meetings within category limits, with clear messages on web and in the app when a limit is reached.
detail: Auto-confirmation respects category daily and total confirmation limits, and the limit settings were renamed with clearer tooltips. The apps enforce the same meeting and message limits as the web, with specific error messages for pending and confirmation limits.

title: Schedule view while booking
benefit: Check your own or your team's schedule without leaving the meeting request page.
detail: The new meeting request flow gained a 'See my Schedule' drawer with a team member selector for exhibitors, and a 'View Today's Schedule' pop-up that keeps form data intact. The break between meetings set by organisers is now always stated on the request screen.

title: Speed networking
benefit: Run timed, table-based networking rounds where checked-in attendees are matched automatically and see who to meet next.
detail: Organisers set up sessions with location, timings, meetings per person and breaks; the platform pairs checked-in participants, lets them reject irrelevant matches, emails schedules and contacts, and shows a live timeline, table view and public display board. Organisers can adjust meetings by hand and export feedback.

title: Content reporting for exhibitor events
benefit: Let attendees report offensive exhibitor events and let organisers reject events on security grounds.
detail: Users report exhibitor events with preset reasons and organisers review the reports against a content policy for exhibitors. A final Rejected for security concern status requires a reason, with filters and a rejection reason column.

title: Sessions list and schedule download options
benefit: Show exhibitor events on the Sessions page and choose which profile fields go into downloaded schedules.
detail: An optional setting lists exhibitor events alongside sessions with a Session Format filter. Registration fields can be flagged for inclusion in the XLS schedule download, and exhibitors can search speakers and moderators by name or title when creating events.

title: Email sender and group search improvements
benefit: Send activation links from the email sender and search within groups.
detail: An Activation link variable in the email sender opens and activates the recipient’s profile, and the Groups tab gains a search filter.

title: Lead download and badge matching
benefit: Download leads in the background and get full details even for badges the scanner did not recognise.
detail: Download leads moved to a button on the profile, generating the file in the background with a timestamped link. Unrecognised badge scans are matched against the event database and filled in with the attendee's details, and organisers can set when lead capture is available.

title: Product and exhibitor setting improvements
benefit: Require key product details, show custom fields on product pages and rename sponsor sections.
detail: Organisers can make product images and descriptions mandatory, show custom field data on product pages and rename the sponsor sections on exhibitor and product lists. Exhibitor manual deadlines can be changed with confirmation and without exhibitors resubmitting.

title: Visitor invitation statistics
benefit: See how many visitors each exhibitor's invitations bring in.
detail: Invite registrations are attributed to exhibitors. Admins get a statistics tab with status counts, top exhibitors, filters, search and Excel export, and exhibitors see their own invitation funnel in their profile.

title: InVisual floor plan integration
benefit: Use InVisual floor plans natively on web and app, linked to exhibitors, sessions and favourites.
detail: Admins configure InVisual in settings. Users open the map from exhibitor, session and event locations, scan venue QR codes into the app or web view, and keep favourites in sync.

title: Badge printing improvements
benefit: Print badges in bulk from the participants page and track badge printing.
detail: The batch print tool works with or without filters: organisers confirm the badge count, a file is generated in the background and a download button appears when ready. Badge print statistics are captured, and exhibitors without badges see a clear message pointing them to where badges are printed.

title: Check-in app zones and actions
benefit: Choose the zone, action and session before scanning in the check-in app, with alerts for duplicate scans.
detail: Staff pick check-in, check-out or session scanning and the zone before they start. Session scans require the item in the attendee’s schedule, a short cooldown avoids accidental double scans, and repeat same-day scans are flagged.

title: Redesigned ExpoFP floor plans in-app
benefit: Search for a booth and get directions on ExpoFP floor plans in the app, with a redesigned layout.
detail: Search results, stand details, get-directions and route panels were redesigned on Android and iOS. Users choose a start point from their current location with Crowd Connected or on the map, swap points and see the route.

title: Export additions
benefit: Export news articles and get more detail in user and meeting exports.
detail: A News export lists articles with author, tags, visibility and exhibitor. The user export shows when each account was activated, and the meetings export shows the parent exhibitor of child-exhibitor participants.

title: Aditus badges in the app
benefit: Show attendees their Aditus tickets on the badge page of the mobile app.
detail: When the Aditus badge integration is switched on, the app's badge menu lists the user's Aditus tickets, found by email.

title: CRM session import
benefit: Import sessions and speakers from a CRM, along with their tracks, types and tags.
detail: A CRM integration, switched on in event setup, pulls sessions and speakers into the agenda with their tracks, types and tags.

title: Event system import enhancements
benefit: Control exactly which sessions, speakers and exhibitor details are imported from the external event system.
detail: Imports now bring in moderators, only the speakers of imported sessions, exhibitor custom fields and categories, tracks and session types, and can filter sessions by stream and seminar name. Fields can be locked from updates and welcome emails sent to imported exhibitors.

title: ExpoFP exhibitor data sync
benefit: Keep ExpoFP floor plans current with exhibitor details sent automatically from the platform.
detail: Exhibitor name, stand, order ID, description, logo and category are pushed to ExpoFP whenever an exhibitor changes, with changes grouped and sent together every ten minutes.

title: Public API improvements
benefit: Set networking opt-in, filter statistics by time and export meeting tags through the public API.
detail: The account endpoint accepts a networking opt-in parameter, statistics endpoints filter by Unix timestamps, stand transmission via the API was improved and meeting tags appear in the meetings export and its endpoint.

title: Admin panel colour update
benefit: Work in an admin panel with updated primary and secondary colours.
detail: The primary and secondary colours of the admin panel were changed.

title: Return to page after SSO
benefit: Send single sign-on users back to the page they originally requested after they authenticate.
detail: A SAML setting returns users to their intended page after authentication instead of the event homepage.

title: Custom forms and pop-ups
benefit: Place marketing forms on the website inline, beside images or videos, as pop-ups or as sidebars, in several languages.
detail: Form blocks embed a chosen marketing form with colour and typography settings. Pop-up and sidebar forms support multi-column layouts and triggers such as exit intent, delay, scroll or page count. A feedback pop-up collects emoji or star ratings with comments, and forms can be multilingual and split into steps.

title: Banners, page slugs and event cloning
benefit: Add rotating banners, see page slugs at a glance and keep the website when cloning an event.
detail: A Banner block shows several linked banners in three sizes with timed rotation. The page list shows each page's slug, and cloning an event copies its new-builder website.

title: Custom CSS and HTML controls
benefit: Fine-tune the website's look with editable custom CSS and full-screen custom HTML.
detail: Existing custom CSS can be edited, custom CSS supports pseudo-classes, custom HTML can be shown full screen, and anchor IDs and custom CSS pass through to the header and footer.

title: Embeddable portal widgets
benefit: Embed portal widgets in other websites with frames that resize to fit their content.
detail: In widget mode the portal reports its height to the host page, and the frame is tracked across the session so the height stays correct.

title: Real-time team editing
benefit: Several admins can edit the same website at once and see who is working where.
detail: The builder shows active users, updates live, locks a block while someone edits it, shares autosave and warns before a version is restored.

title: Recommended for you sorting
benefit: Sort exhibitors, products, delegates, speakers and buyers by AI matchmaking relevance with 'Recommended for you'.
detail: With matchmaking on, listing pages offer 'Recommended for you' alongside A–Z sorting, optionally as the default, with explanatory text. Choosing a column sort in custom listings switches off recommended sorting.

title: Opt-in speed networking
benefit: Invite eligible participants to opt in to speed networking, mark who is relevant ahead of time and get a generated schedule.
detail: Organisers select participants using categories and registration fields, manage a pre-registered list, set sponsored and buyer meeting limits and adjust generated tables by drag and drop. Participants mark relevant matches, see sessions and meetings in their profile, schedule and app, and receive email and bell notifications.

title: Round tables
benefit: Run round table sessions where attendees apply for topics and are seated at tables with a leader or moderator.
detail: Organisers create sessions with topics, see applicants, and manage generated tables with seat editing and leader, moderator and sponsor assignment. Attendees find round tables in sessions, apply for topics, and see their table in My Schedule on web and app, with notifications once seated.

title: Speed networking check-in and voting
benefit: Track speed networking check-in from a registration list and vote on matches with clearer buttons.
detail: Session pages gained a registration list of checked-in participants with filter, search, sort and QR code actions. Voting buttons start neutral and show the chosen vote in colour, and meetings can start one minute after final schedules are sent.

title: Exhibitor event approval workflow
benefit: Review exhibitor events with security questions, auto-approval by type and notifications at every step.
detail: Organisers can require exhibitors to answer custom security questions and accept a policy on submission, auto-approve events by event type, and save changes without approving or rejecting. Email and platform notifications cover submission, approval, rejection and change requests.

title: Clickable custom locations
benefit: Add a link to a session or exhibitor event location so attendees can open it from the card.
detail: With the setting on, other locations can carry a URL that opens from session and exhibitor event cards on the web and in the apps, inside the app for internal pages or in the browser for external ones.

title: Internal notes and critical flags
benefit: Keep back-office notes on sessions and exhibitor events and flag the critical ones for follow-up.
detail: Sessions and exhibitor events gain an internal Notes field and a Flag as critical checkbox, visible only in the back office, with a filter, export columns and import support.

title: Schedule list view in the app
benefit: View a day of meetings, sessions and events as a chronological list in the app.
detail: The app schedule gains a list view grouping meetings, sessions, events and blocked time by hour, and the default view setting now applies to the apps.

title: Session import and filtering improvements
benefit: Import multilingual sessions, link speakers by external code and filter sessions by product category.
detail: The session import maps a name and description field per frontend language and attaches speakers and moderators by external code. A product category display filter is available on the All Sessions, On-demand and Round tables tabs.

title: Campaign and email editor redesign
benefit: Edit campaign variables as tags and get save confirmations in every email template editor.
detail: Campaign variables appear as tags with settings behind a gear icon, with a sender details section and clearer statistics. Unsaved-changes warnings and save confirmations extend to all admin email template editors.

title: Networking filters for lists
benefit: Filter attendee and exhibitor lists by existing chats and meetings.
detail: Delegate, speaker, buyer, exhibitor, pavilion and product lists can be filtered by existing chats, by who initiated meetings and by meeting status, configured in display filters.

title: Redesigned exhibitor account
benefit: Manage every part of an exhibitor from one redesigned account in the admin panel.
detail: The admin exhibitor account has new pages for registration info, settings, team members, security, sponsorship, floor plan and analytics against the event average, plus a refreshed interaction dashboard. Profiles show registration URL, external ID and tags, and new profiles no longer need a password.

title: Automatic parent and child assignment
benefit: Link exhibitors that share an email address as parent and child companies automatically.
detail: A general setting runs a script that makes the first exhibitor with a shared email the parent and later ones its children, showing the last run. Checks in the API and import stop an exhibitor being set as its own parent or child.

title: Clone products and brands with events
benefit: Carry exhibitors' active products and brands into a cloned event.
detail: Event cloning can keep only active products, and can copy brands with their exhibitors, products, logo, categories, description, social links and translations. Interaction data such as favourites is not copied.

title: Lead download controls
benefit: Choose which exhibitor categories or exhibitors can download leads.
detail: Download leads can be switched on or off per exhibitor category or individual exhibitor, including their team members on web and app. Contact-sharing settings were renamed to name exhibitor events and sponsored sessions clearly.

title: Product category and profile improvements
benefit: Limit product categories to an exhibitor's activities and show exhibitor social links in the app.
detail: A setting restricts product categories to an exhibitor's own activity categories. The iOS and Android apps show exhibitor social links from the exhibitor's profile.

title: App behaviour improvements
benefit: Keep attendees on a valid event and make Android sections easier to use.
detail: On launch the app checks the user’s event still exists; if not, the user is logged out and shown the event selection or login screen. Collapsing sections in the Android app behaves more naturally.

title: Report times in event time zone
benefit: See when each report was generated in the event’s own time zone.
detail: Export, import and statistics download links across the admin panel show the generation time in the event time zone, with the zone named.

title: Session report additions
benefit: See exhibitor event status, content reports and edit dates in the sessions export.
detail: The sessions export shows each exhibitor event’s status, including rejection for security concerns, how often it was reported as offensive, and when the exhibitor created and last edited it.

title: Related exhibitor recommendations
benefit: Discover exhibitors similar to the ones you have requested meetings with, and see exhibitor events among your recommendations.
detail: After requesting a meeting, attendees see a pop-up and a schedule page block listing up to 20 related exhibitors. Organisers can also switch on exhibitor events in the Recommendations section.

title: Crowd Connected location and messaging
benefit: Send location-based push messages through Crowd Connected and link app users to their location data.
detail: The apps pass each user's ID to Crowd Connected, Crowd Connected can send notifications with category targeting through a dedicated API, and ExpoFP and Crowd Connected settings can be entered when an app is created.

title: Reach5 accounts at registration
benefit: Let visitors register with an existing Reach5 account, with their details carried across.
detail: Visitor registration checks an email against both systems and creates platform accounts from Reach5 data.

title: Admin panel language choice
benefit: Choose the admin panel language on the login page and keep it between visits.
detail: The new admin panel adds a language selector on the login page, remembers the chosen language, and shows a loader instead of a loading message while event data loads.

title: Consent for embedded videos
benefit: Block embedded videos on exhibitor profiles until the visitor gives consent.
detail: An optional setting, off by default, keeps embedded videos on exhibitor profiles blocked until the user consents.

title: Easier account switching
benefit: Switch between your own, team member, parent and child company accounts from the top menu.
detail: The web account switcher is a dropdown available from the top-right menu and from the name on the profile page, with scrolling when there are more than five accounts.

title: Card and block design improvements
benefit: Arrange and style cards more freely, with more FAQs, consistent image ratios and better link handling.
detail: Cards in card rows and counter blocks can be reordered by drag and drop, FAQ blocks allow more than eight questions, and images use a chosen aspect ratio. Cards have rounded corners and softer shadows, carousel button alignment was improved, and links in text can be opened from their icon.

title: Pop-ups, social links and logo controls
benefit: Show custom HTML as a pop-up, pin social links to the page edge and control where header and footer logos link.
detail: Custom HTML pop-ups have display triggers, auto-close and per-device settings. A social links block attaches to the left or right edge. Header and footer logos can be static or link to any URL. Custom domain setup explains SSL certificate options.

title: New basket and payment page
benefit: Participants and exhibitors can collect items in a redesigned basket and pay by card, PayPal or Parampos on a new payment page.
detail: The participant basket holds tickets, sessions and on-demand sessions; the exhibitor basket holds manual equipment and lead capture items. Both show discounts, taxes and totals and allow payment per section or in full. Items are reserved for 15 minutes on the payment page, and the Basket and Discounts modules control what users see.

title: New ticketing
benefit: Create, edit and clone tickets in a new admin ticketing area, targeted by participant category and check-in location.
detail: Organisers manage tickets from a new Tickets list, setting name, description, category availability and check-in zones on community and regular events. Ticket content can be translated and shows in the visitor’s chosen language.

title: Basket and payment in the app
benefit: Participants can use the new basket and pay for items inside the iOS and Android apps.
detail: The app basket tab opens the new basket with items, prices, discounts and availability checks. The payment page is adapted to the app with PayPal and Parampos support, and session pages in the app connect to the new basket.

title: Ticket pricing tiers
benefit: Sell tickets at different prices across named sales periods, such as early bird.
detail: Tickets can have a fixed price or a dynamic price with several consecutive, named and coloured date ranges up to the event’s last day, each shown with its own price tag.

title: Ticket visibility by country
benefit: Show registrants only the tickets that apply to their category and country.
detail: Tickets can be made visible per category and country, with a country selector in the registration tickets step that syncs with the Country field. An optional setting lets unlisted combinations continue at no charge instead of showing an error.

title: Updated VAT rules
benefit: Charge VAT correctly based on where the billing and paying companies are located.
detail: VAT calculation now considers billing and paying company location, EU VAT number validation and a setting to disable VAT rules; for example, tax is zero when a non-EU billing company charges an EU payer.

title: Blocked time and team schedule improvements
benefit: Limit blocked time to event days and find team members quickly on the Team Schedule page.
detail: An 'Allow blocked time outside the event days' setting restricts blocked-time pickers to event dates and times when switched off. The Team Schedule member selector gained search by name and company.

title: Exhibitor recommendations when booking
benefit: See recommended exhibitors when starting a meeting with an exhibitor from any page.
detail: An exhibitor recommendations pop-up now appears across all pages where a meeting with an exhibitor can be started.

title: Session ratings
benefit: Collect star ratings and feedback on attended sessions on the web and in the app.
detail: Attendees rate sessions they attended with stars and a short comment, or mark that a session did not take place, from a ratings page or a prompt after the session. The apps prompt for ratings singly or in batches, and organisers export ratings with user details.

title: Session scheduling safeguards
benefit: Get warned about location and time clashes when creating sessions and exhibitor events.
detail: A warning appears on front end and admin when a session or exhibitor event is set at the same location and an overlapping time as another. Time zone validation was added, and the Sessions page shows an empty state when there are no sessions.

title: Bulk campaign sending and chat limits
benefit: Send campaigns to large filtered audiences in one action and protect users from chat spam.
detail: Campaigns reach all selected recipients without duplicates in a single send, visible in campaign statistics. A daily limit on starting new chats applies across web and apps, telling users when it is reached.

title: Multilingual admin notifications
benefit: Send admin notifications in each user’s language, including to app users who are not logged in.
detail: Organisers write notification titles and messages per language with a fallback language; users receive them in their profile or app language. Push notifications can also reach app users who are not logged in, opening a chosen page.

title: Lead questions by category and exhibitor
benefit: Set lead capture questions globally, per exhibitor category or per exhibitor.
detail: Lead question logic was improved so questions can be managed at global, category and individual exhibitor level.

title: Marketplace view and category order
benefit: Choose the default marketplace view and the order of category filters.
detail: Organisers set the default marketplace view to cards, list or short list, and drag and drop category filters into order, which applies to category pickers on web and in the app.

title: Sponsor banner controls
benefit: Make sponsor banners display-only and page through long sponsor lists.
detail: A 'Disable links' toggle for each web and app banner location makes banners unclickable, with no redirect or click statistics. Sponsors are displayed with pagination.

title: App builder options
benefit: Tailor app content by login status, font and links from the app builder.
detail: Custom block pages can be shown only to logged-out users; custom blocks can link to the app sign-in page and to other app pages; the Gilroy font can be chosen for headings and text; forms are shown in an embedded frame; and the Download all button can be hidden on custom documents blocks.

title: Tiered app menus
benefit: Organise the app menu into expandable sections with sub-items.
detail: Main menu items show first, and their sub-items appear indented when the parent is expanded, with the parent staying visible.

title: Attendee names in team schedule export
benefit: See who is attending your team’s events in the team schedule export.
detail: The team schedule export lists attendee names for events the team moderates or speaks at; parent exhibitors also see their child companies’ events.

title: Supply and demand graph improvements
benefit: Read marketplace supply and demand by category more easily.
detail: The supply and demand graph tooltip names the product category, and all categories are displayed on the same scale.

title: AI-powered exhibitor search
benefit: Describe what you are looking for in plain language and let AI find matching exhibitors, refining the results with follow-up prompts.
detail: A prompt-based AI search widget sits on the exhibitor list, enabled as its own module with open or sign-in-only access. Organisers can set up to three suggested prompts, and the conversation is kept as visitors move around the site.

title: Public API exhibitor and product controls
benefit: Switch an exhibitor's sponsor pop-up and activate or deactivate products through the public API.
detail: The exhibitor endpoint accepts a sponsor pop-up parameter, and the product endpoint accepts an active or inactive status.

title: Login codes by WhatsApp and SMS
benefit: Send one-time login codes by WhatsApp and SMS as well as email.
detail: Each channel has its own toggle and users receive codes through every enabled channel. SMS uses custom text and WhatsApp a preset template.

title: Admin panel improvements
benefit: Work in a tidier admin panel with fewer redundant settings and clear empty states.
detail: Redundant settings were removed, admin tables show empty states, and modules such as hospitality, exhibitor manual and table taxes can be hidden.

title: Australian hosting region
benefit: Host event platforms on infrastructure in Australia.
detail: Cloud infrastructure was set up in an Australian region.

title: Faster pages and admin lists
benefit: Load sponsor pages, search widgets and admin meeting lists more quickly.
detail: Database connection pooling was added in production, account attributes and event configuration are retrieved and cached more efficiently, and admin table meeting lists, sponsor pages and exhibitor, product and brand search widgets were optimised.

title: Security hardening
benefit: Benefit from stronger protection of account activation and badge scanning.
detail: Activation codes are generated with the account identifier included, and the badge scanning endpoint requires a secure token.

title: Sign-in and profile refinements
benefit: See clearer profile titles and error codes, and sign in through custom login services.
detail: The profile edit page title reflects the account type, the frontend shows error codes, the sign-up prompt was removed from the login page, and the new frontend supports login by token from a custom service.

title: SEO for custom pages
benefit: Custom pages built in the website builder are rendered for search engines, with configurable headings and image alt text.
detail: Every content, dynamic, header and footer block renders in the server response with configurable H1–H6 heading tags, semantic section elements, image alt text and working buttons.

title: Block versioning and updates
benefit: Keep website blocks up to date, updating one block or a whole page after reviewing what has changed.
detail: Blocks are versioned; outdated blocks show an indicator, single updates list the changes before confirming and bulk updates apply across a page.

title: Search-friendly event pages
benefit: Event website pages such as exhibitors, sessions, news and participants now render their content for search engines.
detail: Community, events, news, brand, exhibitor, participant, product, session, group, manual, marketplace and floor plan pages were moved to server-side rendering while keeping their existing blocks and actions. Custom text and HTML also render on the server.

title: Visibility and page access
benefit: Choose who sees each link and button and who can open each custom page.
detail: Header and footer links and block buttons can be shown to everyone, logged-in or logged-out visitors, and a page access tab controls access to each custom page.

title: Website builder improvements
benefit: Cleaner page URLs, linkable card images, adjustable header menu font size and smoother page and news editing.
detail: Custom page URLs drop the /page segment, slugs can be changed before validation, and images in card rows and carousels can link to a URL. Header menu items have a font size slider with overflow into Show More. Legacy colour settings are hidden when the new builder is on, font key errors are shown, and news paging is kept after approvals.

title: Payment setup checks
benefit: Catch payment integration mistakes before they affect checkout, with validation of required fields and PayPal keys.
detail: Required fields for payment integrations are now validated, and an invalid PayPal secret key for the active test or live mode blocks saving with a clear message. The UK VAT validation service connection was also updated.

title: Automatic calendar sync
benefit: Keep meetings and sessions in step with your external calendar automatically after a one-time consent.
detail: Meetings and sessions sync to users' external calendars in the background every six hours, so additions, changes and deletions arrive without manual action.

title: Real-time matchmaking
benefit: Switch on real-time matchmaking recommendations from the admin panel and see their status live.
detail: The admin Matchmaking page now runs on the real-time recommender, with an Enable toggle and a live status of in progress, error or completed. Switching it off shuts the pipeline down.

title: Meeting wizard and profile improvements
