benefit: Spot team members with email problems when booking for them, and share profile links in one click.
detail: The admin meeting wizard marks team members with fake, empty or undeliverable emails. Profile pages gained a Copy button for the public profile link, with a bulk export of links for team members. Meeting limits are displayed more clearly on the front end.

title: Session details in the app
benefit: See full locations on session cards and moderators in the speakers list in the app.
detail: Session and exhibitor event cards in the iOS and Android apps display the complete location, and the iOS speakers list also shows moderators.

title: Longer group descriptions
benefit: Describe community groups more clearly with longer short descriptions.
detail: The character limit for community group short descriptions was raised from 200 to 400.

title: Parent and child companies in app
benefit: Show parent and child companies in the mobile app, with your own labels in every language.
detail: The apps mark parent and child companies, add a Pavilions tab with child counts and a head office or child filter, and sort children alphabetically. Organisers rename the parent, child, pavilion and head office labels per language, and marketplace cards show country and city for parent exhibitors.

title: Exhibitor and sponsor profile improvements
benefit: Show the sessions a company speaks at or sponsors in the app, and embed videos safely.
detail: App exhibitor profiles add 'Sessions we speak at' and 'Sponsored sessions' blocks that respect visibility rules. Embedded video fields on profiles, products and groups are validated, and sponsor profiles gain a back button.

title: Exhibitor manual improvements
benefit: Enforce badge limits and save profile details reliably in the exhibitor manual.
detail: The Add button is disabled with an explanation once the badge limit is reached, the exhibitor profile is saved and submitted with the Submit button, and fields can be hidden in table sections.

title: Event selector improvements
benefit: Help attendees pick the right event in the app.
detail: The Android event selection and login screens show each event’s country and city and order current and past events by event time. Favourite icons on iOS were updated to sharper versions.

title: Login and check-in export improvements
benefit: Separate customer service logins and see session details in check-in exports.
detail: The login data report lists customer service logins separately from web logins, and the check-in list export can show the session ID and name for session, exhibitor event and round table check-ins.

title: Unified recommendations page
benefit: Give attendees one configurable recommendations page on web and app, with sections for matchmaking, products, exhibitors, sessions and people.
detail: Organisers choose, title, order and target each recommendation section, including matchmaking, and preview the page for web or app. The app page shows role icons on recommended people, and the admin page warns when no sections are enabled.

title: A2Z integration enhancements
benefit: Choose which A2Z exhibitors to import by booth status and map their pavilion and hall.
detail: Only exhibitors with the selected booth status are imported, and pavilion and hall codes map to chosen custom fields.

title: Reach5 single sign-on
benefit: Let attendees sign in with Reach5 single sign-on.
detail: The site accepts a Reach5 authorisation code and exchanges it for an access token to log the user in.

title: Visit staff sign-on and meeting rights
benefit: Let exhibitors register their staff through single sign-on and control who can have meetings from Visit data.
detail: A 'Register Your Staff' option under Team Members signs exhibitor admins into the partner system, and a custom question and response set in the Visit integration decides which participants can have meetings.

title: Clearer buttons and messages
benefit: See consistent primary save buttons and clearer validation messages.
detail: Save and similar buttons use the primary button style, and the error shown when an entry has too few characters was reworded.

title: Up-to-date country and city data
benefit: Use country, city and region names and translations that refresh automatically every month.
detail: The country manager now imports country, city and region names and translations from an external reference service, with monthly automatic updates.

title: Header and styling improvements
benefit: Header titles and subtitles display on mobile, and portal elements can be targeted with custom styling.
detail: Header titles and subtitles show on mobile with character limits and colour settings, and portal pages expose CSS classes or data attributes for custom styling.

title: Image alt text and sitemap
benefit: Describe every website image for search engines and screen readers, with an improved sitemap.
detail: Every image in the builder, including header and footer, has an optional alt text field with SEO tips and a warning when empty. Sitemap generation logic was updated.

title: Tickets in the profile and basket
benefit: Participants can view their tickets and buy more from their profile, with new tickets paid for through the basket.
detail: A Tickets tab shows purchased and available tickets. Tickets have their own basket section with discount codes and taxes, and are held for 15 minutes during payment. Organisers get ticketing settings and an on/off toggle with a warning, and tickets with sales become view-only.

title: Option to disable repeated registration
benefit: Treat returning visitors as new registrants when an event should not reuse accounts from other events.
detail: A visitor setting lets users register without a one-time code or their old password even if their email exists on other events, while duplicate prevention, continuous registration and buyer upgrade still apply.

title: Orders and invoices in the profile
benefit: Participants can see everything they have bought and download their invoices from their profile.
detail: The profile Orders section has an Ordered items tab listing purchased tickets and sessions, and an Invoices tab listing paid orders with sortable columns, item breakdowns and invoice download.

title: Ticket category upgrades
benefit: Let participants upgrade to a higher category by buying a ticket and paying only the difference.
detail: When category changes are allowed, participants can buy a ticket of an equal or higher-value category, replacing their current tickets, on desktop and in the app. Their current category is shown on the dashboard and ticketing pages.

title: Meeting button availability checks
benefit: Only offer meetings with exhibitors who have a team member available, on web and in the app.
detail: The Meeting button on exhibitor, pavilion and product cards and profiles checks team member permissions, opt-in, settings and limits. If no team member is available, the button is hidden in the app and the web suggests alternatives.

title: Meeting ratings in the app
benefit: Rate completed meetings in the mobile app with stars, comments and the likely business outcome.
detail: Completed meetings in the app show a 'Rate This Meeting' button with 1–5 stars, comments, likely business outcome or 'did not take place', and ratings can be edited later.

title: Opt-in speed networking for any event
benefit: Use opt-in speed networking with visibility presets and pairing based on relevance and matchmaking score.
detail: Buyers became a tag rather than a separate setup, organisers set two-sided visibility or choose presets, only opted-in eligible users appear in offers, and pairing uses relevance and matchmaking score.

title: Agenda sharing improvements
benefit: Choose who receives an exhibitor’s agenda and show child exhibitors on session cards.
detail: A Send Agenda pop-up in the admin exhibitor list and profile explains the action and lets organisers pick recipients, including team members. Session cards can show child exhibitors.

title: Custom session filters in the app
benefit: Filter sessions in the app with the same custom filters used on the web, in the attendee’s language.
detail: Custom session filters are available in the mobile apps, working with existing filters and search, and custom filter items can be translated.

title: Easy session check-in
benefit: Let attendees check in to sessions and exhibitor events even if they did not add them to their schedule.
detail: An optional Easy Entrance setting in Sessions config allows check-in without errors for sessions and exhibitor events not in the attendee’s schedule.

title: Configurable session reminders
benefit: Choose when session and exhibitor event reminders are sent.
detail: Organisers pick reminder times from 0 to 60 minutes before a session or exhibitor event starts, replacing fixed reminder times, on the web and in the app.

title: Personal assistant email copies
benefit: Copy a participant’s emails to their personal assistant.
detail: A Personal Assistant Email field in registration copies emails sent to participants, buyers and team members to the assistant’s address.

title: Smarter category selection and search
benefit: Find the right category quickly, even in long, nested category lists.
detail: A redesigned category picker offers a two-panel view by custom filter with direct search. Category filters with many items can show a search field across marketplace, delegate and news pages, and results show matching categories with their parents and children.

title: Lead scanning improvements
benefit: Sync offline scans on demand and see clearer scan reasons in reports.
detail: A 'Force scans sync' button in app settings sends locally edited scans, notes and ratings to the server so they appear in the leads file. The reason for scanning is labelled more clearly in reports.

title: Parent and child display controls
benefit: Choose whether child companies are shown and show parent locations in the app.
detail: A 'Do not indicate child companies' setting hides child relations on web and in the apps. App cards and profiles show country and city for parent exhibitors and pavilions, and the automatic assignment can run daily with an emailed report.

title: Team member and news settings
benefit: Decide which team member fields are required and get better news header images.
detail: Organisers control whether telephone and job title are required when adding team members, and the news header image cropper uses a new ratio.

title: Ticket validation at check-in
benefit: Validate attendees’ tickets when their badge is scanned in the check-in app.
detail: On each scan the app checks that a ticket is held, valid for the date, not expired and valid for the check-in zone, and shows clear messages such as “No ticket found” or “Wrong check-in zone”. No checks run when ticketing is off.

title: Floor plan display improvements
benefit: Keep the floor plan consistent with the rest of the event website.
detail: Exhibitor filters on the floor plan page follow the order set in display filters, and the floor plan uses the standard website builder header instead of its own mini header.

title: GPS and indoor positioning options
benefit: Show attendees their live GPS position on floor plans on Android as on iOS, and choose GPS, indoor positioning or both.
detail: Android app users see their GPS position on InVisual floor plans, with permission prompts. For ExpoFP with Crowd Connected, organisers choose IPS only, GPS only or IPS plus GPS in general settings.

title: Redesigned badge templates
benefit: Create badges with a redesigned templating and output process.
detail: Badge templating and badge output were redesigned.

title: Manual data re-sync
benefit: Let attendees refresh the app’s event data themselves from Settings.
detail: A Re-sync button on the Settings page fetches the latest data, up to once an hour; logged-in users also find Cancel Registration and Delete My Account there. Text blocks were removed from the app builder.

title: Total meetings graph update
benefit: See meeting totals displayed with updated logic in meeting analytics.
detail: The display logic of the Total meetings graph was updated.

title: Aditus participant sync
benefit: Sync participants and team members from Aditus for one or more events.
detail: Registrations are pulled from Aditus with category mapping, badge fields and email options, and the Aditus badge page settings are available again in the admin panel.

title: Klipso integration enhancements
benefit: Bring exhibitor admins, multiple stands and product categories across from Klipso.
detail: Contact person details become the exhibitor's admin team member, optionally set as active, exhibitors can have several halls and stands, and product categories can be copied from an earlier event.

title: Public API improvements
benefit: Filter meeting exports by creation and change dates, remove team members and fetch badge QR codes through the API.
detail: The meetings export accepts created and last-modified date filters, sending empty exhibitor IDs detaches a team member, and the account endpoint returns the participant's badge QR code.

title: Attendee onboarding
benefit: Guide attendees to pick their interests on first login so recommendations are personalised from the start.
detail: Organisers configure a multilingual onboarding pop-up with live preview, texts, category groups, mandatory or optional completion and reappearance timing. It runs on web and app, and users are notified when their recommendations page is updated.

title: Custom labels
benefit: Rename page and section labels in each language across web and app.
detail: A content settings page lets organisers edit labels per language, with all and modified-only views, including labels in the cancel registration and delete account pop-ups.

title: Admin panel improvements
benefit: See the event time zone in the admin panel and keep settings consistent between admin panels.
detail: The admin panel shows the selected event time zone, and settings made in the previous admin panel apply in the new one.

title: Landing page after login
benefit: Choose which page exhibitors, participants and team members land on after they log in.
detail: The page opened on login can be a custom internal URL, and the redirect is handled on the server.

title: Performance and security improvements
benefit: Load large option lists and data faster, with less sensitive data sent in requests.
detail: Additional database indexes were added, multi-select fields with many options load on demand, and tokens and identifiers were removed from requests.

title: Mobile layout for card rows
benefit: Four-card rows display better on mobile devices.
detail: The mobile layout of the four-card view used in system pages was adjusted.

title: Phone number validation
benefit: Reduce invalid phone numbers with format validation on the phone field.
detail: The phone field now validates the format of the value entered.

title: Translated invoices and tax names
benefit: Show invoices and tax names in each event language.
detail: Invoices can be translated, and tax names can be set per event language so they appear translated on invoices, the basket, exhibitor manuals, tickets and ordered items.

title: AI meeting notes
benefit: Record meetings in the app after a badge scan and receive an AI summary by email.
detail: A first release of AI meeting notes in the app covers voice sample onboarding, recording from the Scans tab after a badge scan, explicit consent and emailed AI summaries. Organisers switch it on in the app builder.

title: Admin meeting wizard improvements
benefit: Find the right team member fast when booking meetings for exhibitors in the admin panel.
detail: The meeting wizard team member dropdown is sorted A–Z, shows job title and company and supports search. The exhibitor profile Team Members table combines columns and adds a phone column.

title: Meeting programmes
benefit: Take part in hosted meeting programmes: mark who you want to meet, confirm proposed meetings and follow your schedule.
detail: Participants mark people Relevant or Super Relevant with an optional message, see who picked them and mutual matches, and confirm or decline meetings by round. They follow a timeline, see their schedule and a connections dashboard, get calendar files for deadlines and rate meetings afterwards; exhibitors manage their team.

title: Round table confirmation and reassignment
benefit: Ask round table participants to confirm their seat and move people between topics and tables.
detail: An optional confirmation step lets participants confirm or reject their topic and table, with statuses organisers can filter. Organisers see each topic's applicants and can move or remove participants by drag and drop. Notifications, tooltips and the admin and front-end views were also refined.

title: Applications for exhibitor events
benefit: Let attendees apply for places at exhibitor events and let organisers approve applicants on the web and in the app.
detail: Exhibitor events can use an application deadline with manual or first-come approval. Organisers review applicants on an Applications tab with status filters, search and clash details; applicants are notified and emailed when approved or rejected, and can request or cancel places in the app.

title: Session attendee management
benefit: Manage who is scheduled for or has attended a session from a dedicated tab.
detail: Attendees and Favourited move from the session and exhibitor event edit page to a separate Attendees tab, where organisers add or remove scheduled users and mark attendance. After saving, organisers stay on the session’s edit page instead of returning to the list.

title: Speaker profile events in the app
benefit: See the exhibitor events a speaker or moderator is taking part in from their app profile.
detail: Speaker and moderator profiles in the mobile app gain an Events block listing their active, visible exhibitor events with date, time and an add-to-schedule button.

title: Advanced campaign and notification targeting
benefit: Target emails and notifications by session, round table and meeting programme activity.
detail: Campaign and notification filters cover session, round table and exhibitor event attributes, profile completeness and meeting programme activity. New campaign variables show each recipient’s meeting programme status and assigned round tables; meeting programme filters appear only when that module is on.

title: Registration email variables
benefit: Use any registration form field in registration email templates.
detail: Registration email templates for visitors, speakers, moderators and exhibitors can use all system and custom registration fields, grouped as General, System and Custom. Leaderboard tooltips were also reworded.

title: Lead Capture Pro
benefit: Sell lead capture to exhibitors as a paid package for their whole team.
detail: Organisers configure paid lead capture packages and their presentation, and track payments and revenue. Exhibitors buy access for their team, and in the app the Scan Badges page is shown only to exhibitors who have purchased it.

title: Discount codes in the exhibitor manual
benefit: Offer exhibitors discount codes on equipment ordered through the exhibitor manual.
detail: Discount codes apply to items in the Equipment section, targeted by exhibitor category and item. Exhibitors and team members apply codes in the basket, and admins see and export discount usage.

title: Exhibitor dashboard and sponsor banner improvements
benefit: Top performers show all-time results, and banners without links behave consistently in the app.
detail: The exhibitor dashboard's Top Performers block always shows all-time data. On iOS and Android, tapping a sponsored banner that has no website link behaves consistently.

title: Stand bookmarking on floor plans
benefit: Bookmark stands, sessions, events and custom locations on the ExpoFP floor plan in the app.
detail: App users bookmark a location with a confirmation message and revisit their bookmarks from a list in the floor plan header.

title: Animated ring on live digital badges
benefit: Help staff spot screenshots of badges and check attendee category at a glance.
detail: Live digital badges can show a moving ring around the QR code in the attendee’s category colour, switched on per event.

title: Attendee category at check-in
benefit: See each attendee’s category when checking them in, in the check-in app and at kiosks.
detail: The check-in app shows the participant category after a scan and in the manual-add and scanned lists, and kiosks show the visitor category next to names. The app’s logout button is easier to find and asks for confirmation.

title: Scrolling location text
benefit: Read long location names in full on session and networking detail pages in the app.
detail: Location buttons on session, exhibitor event, round table and speed networking pages scroll long text continuously and stay static when it fits.

title: Meeting programme reports
benefit: Download a full report of a meeting programme’s relevance actions, acceptances and meetings.
detail: A Generate XLS Report button on meeting programme details produces a multi-tab, timestamped report with per-attendee counts of generated, accepted, rejected and confirmed meetings, sponsored and free.

title: Event system data push-back
benefit: Send exhibitors, news and exhibitor content from the platform back to the external event system.
detail: Exhibitors in selected categories, approved news and exhibitor manual brochures, images and videos flow to the external system with an agreed field mapping, including product export columns.

title: Participant and exhibitor list endpoints
benefit: Fetch all participants and exhibitors through paginated API v2 endpoints that return only what changed.
detail: New endpoints list participants and exhibitors with their details, including parent and child companies, with timestamp filters. Deleted participant IDs can also be retrieved.

title: Admin panel safeguards
benefit: Avoid accidental changes with warnings on category changes and stronger validation.
detail: Admins confirm participant category changes after a warning that they may affect access, visibility and matchmaking. Region values are validated, and the save and cancel bar is blurred behind for readability.

title: Invoice payment during registration
benefit: Let participants choose to pay by invoice when buying paid items during registration.
detail: With the new setting on, registrants can pay by invoice; their paid sessions are scheduled, and the activation email is sent once the organiser confirms payment in Invoice payments.

title: Lock participant categories
benefit: Prevent participant categories being changed in the admin panel once registration is set up.
detail: An optional registration setting, off by default, locks the participant category field in the admin panel for all admins.

title: Switch between ticketing versions
benefit: Choose old or new ticketing per event or for all events without losing existing tickets.
detail: A module toggle selects the ticketing version per event or globally. Each version keeps its own tickets and settings, and users’ tickets are kept.

title: Remaining meetings with auto-confirm
benefit: Cap auto-confirmed meetings at the exhibitor category limit and show how many meetings remain.
detail: When auto-confirm is on, exhibitor category meeting limits still apply, and the remaining meeting count is displayed on the front end.

title: Meeting programme management
benefit: Configure and run meeting programmes from the admin panel, from roles and participants through to tables and final schedules.
detail: Organisers set roles, limits and a custom timeline, manage the pre-registered list with dashboards, and review generated meetings in confirmation, schedule and table views with search and filters. They can create or move meetings manually. Both generation runs create sponsored and free meetings, with email and platform notifications at each step.

title: Meeting programmes in the app
benefit: Follow meeting programmes in the mobile app with notifications, schedule cards and meeting ratings.
detail: App users are notified when added, removed or when final schedules are sent, see placeholder and then per-meeting cards with table numbers in My Schedule, filter them, and rate their meetings.

title: Round table numbering
benefit: Give every round table in a session a unique number that never shifts.
detail: Table numbers run in one sequence across all topics in a session; new tables take the smallest free number.

title: Notification and information request improvements
benefit: Open items from the notification dropdown and ask participants for missing registration details.
detail: Notifications in the dropdown are clickable. A participant information request email template and a Send Information Request action in participant profiles and lists let organisers request missing details.

title: ExpoFP stands with hall numbers
benefit: Link exhibitors to ExpoFP stands whether stand numbers include the hall or not.
detail: The apps follow ExpoFP’s “Map with Hall” setting, matching stands as hall plus stand (for example “Halle 3.0 G61”) or stand only (“G61”).

title: Programme and round table reports
benefit: Get more detail in meeting programme reports and export round table assignments.
detail: The meeting programme report adds each exhibitor’s sponsored meeting limit and a relevance tab covering all user types. Each round table session has an export listing assigned attendees with topic and table number.

title: Public API v3
benefit: Start building on the new Public API v3, beginning with events, categories and registration questions.
detail: The first v3 endpoints list an environment's events, exhibitor and participant categories, and the custom questions of the visitor registration pipeline.

title: Visit integration on API V2
benefit: Sync participants and exhibitors with Visit in near real time, with automatic retries and full request logs.
detail: The integration moved to Visit's V2 API, receives updates as they happen, pushes chosen fields back and runs an end-of-day push. Deletions are handled, profile pictures sync both ways, failed calls retry automatically and every request is logged in the admin panel.

title: Genesis World integration
benefit: Connect the platform with the Genesis World CRM.
detail: The first phase of a native integration with Genesis World was delivered.

title: Editor and admin panel tidy-ups
benefit: Clear formatting from text in one click and work without the maintenance banner.
detail: The text editor has a remove styling button, and the maintenance warning was removed from the admin panels.

title: Fewer requests and faster search
benefit: Get a quicker app and delegate search with fewer calls to the server.
detail: The app sends fewer requests to the server, delegate search responses are lighter, and location data is cached.

title: Protection against script injection
benefit: Benefit from protection against cross-site scripting where HTML content is allowed.
detail: Cross-site scripting issues were fixed in places where HTML content is supported.

title: Custom grids
benefit: Build multi-column page layouts without code, and they still look right on mobile.
detail: Custom grids take one to six cells, can sit inside other grids and accept text, buttons, images and video by drag and drop. Cells resize and wrap on smaller screens, and a Buttons block adds as many styled buttons as a section needs.

title: Carousel and text editor refinements
benefit: Carousels behave sensibly with few items, and text editor controls match the builder's theme.
detail: Blocks switch from a swiping slider to a static layout when there are not enough slides, and text editor controls inherit the builder's theme.

title: Country visibility in new ticketing
benefit: Target new-style tickets by the registrant’s country as well as category.
detail: Ticket visibility by country, previously available in the older ticketing, is now part of the new ticketing.

title: Matchmaking and booking improvements
benefit: Get more precise matchmaking and spot every available time slot when booking.
detail: Matchmaking was refined for more precise results, and the meeting time picker now shows a scroll hint so users see that more slots are available below.

title: Meeting programme attendance tracking
benefit: Record completed meetings by badge or QR scan and flag no-shows as an organiser or participant.
detail: Meeting programme meetings can be completed by QR or badge scan, and both organisers and participants can mark a no-show. Ratings open in the app once final schedules are received.

title: Meeting programme improvements
benefit: Run meeting programmes with a simpler participant view, split voting phases, early exhibitor access and more organiser control.
detail: Voting phases were split and tabs restructured, meeting blocks combine into one schedule list, and exhibitors can get early access. Organisers gained sorting in relevance and opt-in phases, manual meeting deletion, timeslot blocking, optional conditions for team members and a switch to disable notifications; deleted users are removed.

title: Round table seating controls
benefit: Add people to tables after final schedules and set a limit on the number of tables.
detail: Organisers can add users to a table after the final schedule is sent and define a tables limit. Deleted users are removed from sessions, and round tables run on a new dedicated service.

title: Speed networking push notifications
benefit: Receive opt-in speed networking updates as push notifications on iOS and Android.
detail: Push notifications for opt-in speed networking were set up in the iOS and Android apps.

title: Exhibitor event auto-approval rules
benefit: Set up automatic approval for exhibitor event applications with a required capacity limit.
detail: A new auto-approval interface and mechanism for exhibitor event applications, a required limit when the approval process is on, and removal of rejection notifications. Exhibitor events are sorted consistently in exhibitor profiles, and app content settings include exhibitor events.

title: Messenger conversation filters
benefit: Spot unanswered conversations at a glance.
detail: Messenger filters conversations into two-way chats, where both sides have replied, and one-way chats still waiting for an answer, alongside the existing filters.

title: Attend a stand
benefit: Attendees can take part in stand activity, with the listing also available in the app.
detail: Adds an 'Attend a stand' capability, with its listing shown in the mobile app.

title: Category filter cloning and profile loading
benefit: Reuse product category filters within an event and see team members load smoothly.
detail: Organisers can clone product category custom filters within an event instead of rebuilding them, and the team members section of public exhibitor profiles shows a loader.

title: Lead capture app improvements
benefit: Never lose a scanned lead, even on unreliable venue networks.
detail: The lead capture form autosaves when an exhibitor leaves it, closes the app or loses connection, then syncs. The Scan Badges page follows Lead Capture Pro access rules, and the custom questions page in the exhibitor profile is clearer.

title: Offline ExpoFP floor plans
benefit: Use ExpoFP floor plans in the app without an internet connection.
detail: The mobile apps provide full offline support for ExpoFP floor plans.

title: Bookmarks synced with favourites
benefit: Keep favourites and floor plan bookmarks in step automatically.
detail: Favourites and floor plan bookmarks now sync in both directions, so an item saved in one place appears in the other.

title: Check-in and QR code improvements
benefit: Use a simplified participant QR code and a refined zone filter in the check-in list.
detail: Admins can choose a new “Simplified Participant QR” code type, and the zone filter in the admin check-in list has new limits.

title: Clearer custom badge errors with Aditus
benefit: Tell attendees what to do when their Aditus custom badge cannot be shown.
detail: Instead of silently falling back to the standard badge, users are taken to a clear error page for no-connection and no-information cases, available in English and German.

title: App usability improvements
benefit: Open sessions from links, and get clearer feedback on profiles and tickets.
detail: Deep links open sessions directly in the app. The About me section on delegate profiles on iOS was updated, and the Tickets page shows a loading spinner while updating on iOS and Android.

title: Event data reset without logout
benefit: Reset event data in the app mid-event without logging attendees out.
detail: The admin panel’s global resync performs a full reset of app data without logging users out, matching the resync in the app’s settings.

title: Export additions
benefit: Analyse profile completion and new exhibitors in your own reporting tools.
detail: Participant exports include profile completion, the exhibitor export shows whether each exhibitor is new, and the team member export includes external QR codes.

title: Meeting programme report additions
benefit: See how each meeting was generated and how it was rated in the programme report.
detail: The All meetings tab of the meeting programme report shows how each meeting was generated and the rating it received.

title: Better search in the mobile app
benefit: Search exhibitor descriptions in the app and see exhibitors whose names match your query at the top.
detail: Mobile search now looks at descriptions as well as names, and orders exhibitor results so name matches come before description matches.

title: More accurate AI search results
benefit: Find the right exhibitor even with spelling variants, spacing differences or partial names, with helpful suggestions when nothing matches.
detail: Exact name matches now outrank description mentions in results and autocomplete, country and accent variants are recognised, spaced and joined-up names match, parent and child exhibitors follow a consistent order, and empty searches offer 'Did you mean' and category suggestions.

title: Map Your Show integration
benefit: Import exhibitors from Map Your Show, with custom fields and product categories.
detail: Built on the integration hub, the integration fetches exhibitors from the Map Your Show API with their custom fields and product categories, and a second stage completed the remaining requirements.

title: Integration hub mapping improvements
benefit: Map more data through the integration hub, including team member roles, default language and Aditus exhibitor data.
detail: Team member roles can be set in the mapping without downgrading existing admins on resync, exhibitor mappings include a default language field, and exhibitor and team member data can be pushed to Aditus.

title: More Public API v3 endpoints
benefit: Check accounts, read registration questions, export meetings and pull check-in data through Public API v3.
detail: New v3 endpoints check whether an account exists, return visitor and exhibitor registration custom questions, export meetings with filters and incremental sync, and provide check-in data. Emails can also be used when creating accounts through the API.

title: Locale-aware dates and translations
benefit: Show dates in the format of each user’s language, with more complete translations.
detail: Date formats follow the locale, and missing languages and system translations were added.

title: More sign-in options
benefit: Offer both single sign-on and standard login, including a second external login option in the app.
detail: The sign-in modal offers SAML single sign-on or standard login, the mobile app can show a configurable second external login button, and sign-in buttons gain a hover colour.

title: Profile completion tracking
benefit: See each participant’s profile completion in the admin panel with a more accurate score.
detail: The profile completion calculation was updated, and the admin participants list shows each participant’s completion status.

title: Stay on page when saving
benefit: Save changes in the admin panel without losing your place, and see a warning while an event is cloning.
detail: Saving or applying changes in key admin modules keeps organisers on the same page. A persistent banner across admin pages warns not to edit an event while it is being cloned.

title: Card styling options
benefit: Give every card view borders and shadows, and hide the button on individual cards without custom CSS.
detail: Border and shadow options were added to card views that lacked them, and each card has a toggle to show or hide its call-to-action button.

title: Footer layout controls
benefit: Lay out the website footer more precisely, with column alignment, text position and logo width settings.
detail: Footer columns can be aligned and deleted, text position is configurable and logo plus text width can be set. The 'Powered by ExpoPlatform' footer branding can be shown or hidden per event.

title: Meeting notes, private and AI
benefit: Keep private notes on every meeting, and get AI meeting notes in the language the meeting was held in.
detail: Attendees add a private note when requesting a meeting or from their schedule, on web and in the app, and find every note in one My Notes panel. AI meeting notes are produced in the meeting language, with one shared list of action points for all participants.

title: Meeting setup improvements
benefit: Set up matchmaking categories faster and get improved table meeting setup and meeting cards in the app.
detail: Selecting a parent category in Networking & Matchmaking now selects all its child categories. The app gained improvements to table meeting setup and meeting cards.

title: Centralised meeting formats admin
benefit: Manage speed networking, meeting programmes, concierge meetings, round tables and exhibitor events from one place.
detail: Module management for meeting formats was restructured, with a central area for speed networking, meeting programmes and concierge meetings. Email templates for every format are managed there, round tables are managed independently, and exhibitor events management was enhanced.

title: Smarter meeting generation
benefit: Get fuller, fairer generated schedules for speed networking and meeting programmes.
detail: Meetings are spread more evenly across participants, likes can be pooled across an exhibitor's team, one-sided likes can count as mutual for chosen role directions, and extra pairs can be generated where no likes exist. Invalid input now returns an error rather than creating meetings in blocked slots, and sponsored limits no longer block organiser-created meetings.

title: External session registration links
benefit: Send attendees from a session’s Register button to an external registration or payment page.
detail: Organisers set a per-session external registration URL with a custom button label and an external-link icon, used during the pre-event and live event.

title: Now and upcoming sessions
benefit: Jump straight to what is on now and next in the app’s session list.
detail: On the current day, the mobile Sessions list scrolls to the current time with a now separator and highlights Now and Upcoming sessions.

title: Session cards and admin filters
benefit: Find sessions faster in admin and see type and host details on session cards.
detail: The admin Sessions and Exhibitor Events pages gain filter sections such as session type. Detail cards show the session or exhibitor event type, and exhibitor event cards show the hosting exhibitor’s name.

title: Clearer recommendation blocks in emails
benefit: Send campaign emails whose recommendation blocks are full width and clearly separated.
detail: Recommendation blocks in organiser campaign emails use full-width card layouts with clear boundaries, matching the visitor-side design.

title: Lead Capture Pro access control
benefit: Grant lead capture, product QR codes and AI notes by exhibitor category or individual exhibitor.
detail: Organisers enable lead capture, product QR codes and AI meeting notes per exhibitor category or per exhibitor from one consolidated settings area. The purchase page marks features already granted as purchased, and standard questions have a configurable default state.

title: Exhibitor permissions and team rules
benefit: Product visibility follows the exhibitor's restrictions, and team logins stay unique.
detail: Products inherit their exhibitor's visibility and message and meeting restrictions on web and mobile. Team member creation rules were updated with login uniqueness checks, and Google+ was removed from brand social links.

title: Lead capture improvements
benefit: Protect attendee privacy at the stand and see richer lead details.
detail: Attendee emails can be shown only after a badge scan. Scanned visitor QR codes include team members, lead contribution counts meeting appointments, notes have a character limit, and interaction dashboards show each participant's company.

title: Multilingual exhibitor manual documents
benefit: Give exhibitors the exhibitor manual document in their own language.
detail: Organisers upload a separate file for each event language within one exhibitor manual entry, and exhibitors see only the file for their selected language.

title: Random sponsor order and visibility
benefit: Rotate sponsors fairly and make sure sponsor names always show.
detail: Sponsors and sponsored products can be shown in random order on web and in the app, or by matchmaking score in the app. The legacy view shows up to 150 sponsors, sponsor names always appear on session cards and pages, and the custom sponsor limit has a tooltip.

title: OCR badge scanning
benefit: Capture badge details by reading the printed text with OCR when scanning.
detail: Badge scanning can use optical character recognition to read badges.

title: Floor plan management improvements
benefit: Manage halls and stands on large internal floor plans faster.
detail: Halls and stands can be sorted in natural order and deleted in bulk with multi-select, and hidden halls can be opened from an exhibitor’s card.

title: Offline feedback for favourites
benefit: Let users know when a favourite cannot be saved because they are offline.
detail: Tapping Favourite without a connection shows the app’s standard connection-lost message across lists, profiles and recommendations on Android and iOS.

title: Automated event reporting dashboards
benefit: Track exhibitors, attendees, app adoption, meetings, sessions and products in ready-made dashboards in Analytics.
detail: New dashboards sit in their own Analytics section: exhibitor analytics, attendee analytics, platform performance, mobile app downloads and adoption, meetings and messaging, top sessions and session types, and product categories and listings, with KPI cards, trends, filtering and drill-down.

title: Co-located event check-in comparison
benefit: Compare check-ins across co-located events and see attendees who cross over.
detail: The total check-in and check-out graph compares co-located events and shows crossover check-ins, filterable by badge origin.

title: Faster report exports
benefit: Download session and booking reports faster and more reliably on large events.
detail: The by-session export was reworked to run in the background more reliably, and the by-booking report loads each page with a fixed set of queries.

title: Google Analytics 4 support
benefit: Track event website traffic with Google Analytics 4.
detail: GA4 tracking works again on event websites, and the Google Analytics ID field in the admin panel validates the GA4 format, with placeholder and help text; leaving it empty turns tracking off.

title: Meeting outcome columns in reports
benefit: See whether meetings took place and how likely they are to lead to business.
detail: The meetings report and custom meeting wizard report include business transaction likelihood and meeting did not take place columns.

title: AI event assistant for sessions
benefit: Ask the AI event assistant about sessions by day, topic, time or format instead of scrolling through the full agenda.
detail: A sessions and agenda tool was built into the first phase of the AI event assistant, so it can answer attendee questions about the programme.

title: AI search across the event
benefit: Search exhibitors, people, sessions, products and news semantically, with filters and paging that work alongside AI relevance.
detail: A new AI search service indexes exhibitors, team members, products, people, sessions and news, and stays up to date as data changes. Marketplace filters narrow AI results, and results can be paged beyond the first set.

title: New recommendation service
benefit: Get category-based recommendations and matching scores from a rebuilt recommendation service that responds quickly from the first request.
detail: The service calculates matching scores from category similarity and provides recommendations through a new API. Start-up delay on an event's first request was cut, and caching now updates incrementally.

title: Public API v3 content endpoints
benefit: Pull sponsors, products, floor plan halls and stands, session metadata and reference data through Public API v3.
detail: New v3 endpoints return sponsors and sponsor categories, products and exhibitors, and event-scoped floor plan halls and stands. Session tracks, types, tags and languages, countries and regions follow with localisation, sorting, paging and modified-since filters.

title: CDS participant integration
benefit: Sync large volumes of registrations from CDS reliably.
detail: Participants are pulled from CDS page by page with full field mapping, matched by email for updates, with order type and included items set in the admin panel.

title: D2i integration
benefit: Import registration and attendee data from D2i automatically.
detail: A native integration searches and pages through D2i registrations and syncs only changed records, with D2i as the source of truth.

title: Integrations move to the integration hub
benefit: Run the Aventri, Aditus and A2Z integrations on the integration hub.
detail: The Aventri V2, Aditus and A2Z integrations were migrated to the integration hub.

title: Admin panel navigation and pagination
benefit: Move through admin lists consistently and return to the page you were on.
detail: Pagination is standardised across admin listings and remembers your position as you navigate. The sponsorship section moved as part of a navigation restructure, and the colour picker rejects invalid values.

title: Lighter requests and loading feedback
benefit: Get faster page loads with fewer unnecessary requests.
detail: Empty banner placements are no longer requested repeatedly, unnecessary sign-in checks and database connections were cut, and file download buttons in the user profile show a loader.

title: Security hardening
benefit: Benefit from protection against email flooding and tighter API error handling.
detail: The resend endpoint is rate limited per IP with temporary blocking, and the schedule note API no longer exposes internal server details in errors and enforces authorisation.

title: AI-assisted website styling
benefit: Restyle website blocks by describing the change in plain language and let AI generate on-brand CSS.
detail: Organisers describe a change in everyday words; the builder sends the block's structure and design tokens through a secure server-side connection, shows the generated CSS for review and applies it only to that block.

title: Editable marketing tracking links
benefit: Edit the name and destination of existing tracking links without recreating and re-sharing them.
detail: Each tracking link has an edit action to update its name and landing page URL, with validation.

title: Header layout and mobile search
benefit: Choose header scroll behaviour and line layout, and search by category on mobile.
detail: Header menus gain scroll settings and a line layout. Mobile header search shows the categories selector and its panel pushes content down instead of covering it.

title: New registration experience
benefit: Registrants move through a rebuilt, step-by-step registration with tickets, sessions, a summary and payment in one flow.
detail: Email verification catches duplicates and resumes unfinished or repeat registrations with data pre-filled. Tabs with a live order summary cover conditional fields, tickets held during checkout, session booking, discount codes, terms and payment. Category links pre-filter tickets, and organisers switch each event to the new flow when ready.

title: Approval, buyer and waiting-list flows
benefit: Run approval-based, buyer and capacity-limited registrations in the new flow, with payment collected after approval.
detail: Private events with public access and buyer registrations submit for organiser approval, then pay through the basket once activated. Participants can upgrade to buyer with pre-filled data, and registrations over the limit join a waiting list with its own email.

title: Branded registration pages
benefit: Brand the registration welcome, confirmation and sold-out pages for participants and buyers without custom code.
detail: A visual constructor sets hero image, title and description per language for welcome pages. Confirmation pages support merge variables such as name, QR code and badge link, scripts or a custom website page. A sold-out page offers a configurable call-to-action button.

title: Checkout and payment admin improvements
benefit: Complete free bookings in one step, find payments quickly and keep app registrants in the flow when reading the terms.
detail: Bookings with a total of zero skip the payment form and go straight to the success page. Transaction and invoice payment pages can be searched by payer name or email. In the app, the terms of use open in the device browser.

title: AI meeting notes add-on
benefit: Offer AI meeting notes to exhibitors as a paid Lead Capture Pro add-on they can buy themselves.
detail: Organisers enable AI meeting notes as a Lead Capture Pro add-on and set its price in the event's payment currency. Exhibitors see and buy it on the Lead Capture Pro page, unlocking AI transcription for their whole team.

title: Meeting management improvements
benefit: Respond to meetings in bulk without waiting for large teams to load, and restrict meetings with exhibitors without teams in the app.
detail: Bulk Respond now opens instantly regardless of team size and refreshes after changes are applied. The mobile app respects the setting that restricts meetings with exhibitors who have no team members.

title: Round table waitlist replacement
benefit: Fill freed round table seats from the waitlist with eligible candidates detected automatically.
detail: Waitlist replacement now works out eligible candidates itself: applicants who have not already been invited to a seat in any generation or earlier replacement.

title: Session calendar view
benefit: Browse the agenda in a day, week or multi-day calendar, search it and add sessions without leaving the view.
detail: The calendar handles overlapping sessions, shows a live now indicator and marks sessions already in the attendee’s schedule. Search by title or speaker, a slide-out drawer with session details and bookmarking, logged-out browsing and optional exhibitor events in the mobile calendar are included.

title: Default view and track colours
benefit: Choose the default layout of the Sessions page and give tracks custom colours.
detail: A Default view setting in Sessions config makes List, Grid or Calendar the first layout attendees see on the Sessions and Exhibitor Events pages, and tracks can have custom colours.

title: Exhibitor event location improvements
benefit: Place exhibitor events at any floor plan location and translate predefined locations.
detail: An optional setting lets exhibitor events use any live floor plan location, not just the exhibitor’s stand. Predefined other locations can be stored per language, and exhibitor events show even when no team member is assigned.

title: Custom SMTP email sending
benefit: Send platform emails through your own SMTP service.
detail: A setting lets organisers use a custom SMTP service for sending emails.

title: Exhibitor insights portal
benefit: Exhibitors see the results of their event participation in one place.
detail: The first insights page shows leads captured, meetings held, profile views, message reply rate, best single day and benchmarking against peers, based on real event data.

title: Lead Capture Pro per team member
benefit: Turn lead capture and AI meeting notes on for individual team members, with unlimited questions for buyers.
detail: The app applies lead capture and AI meeting notes access per exhibitor owner and team member. Exhibitors who buy custom questions get unlimited standard and additional lead questions.

title: Region filters and brand import
benefit: Filter listings by region and keep exhibitors' brands when they join new events.
detail: An optional Region filter nested under Country narrows exhibitor and participant listings on web. Exhibitor import and adding from the global database attach an exhibitor's existing brands, and exhibitor settings include a logo option.

title: Sponsored placements in global search
benefit: Sell sponsored banners, exhibitors and products on the global search page.
detail: Global search shows a sponsorship banner plus rotating sponsored exhibitor and sponsored product blocks with configurable labels and colours. Sponsor cards now show location, tags and products, and exhibitors with several stands display them clearly.

title: App branding and typography
benefit: Apply a custom typeface consistently across every Android screen.
detail: A custom font set in the app builder now covers all remaining Android screens for a consistent look, and the app shows ExpoPlatform branding.

title: Sponsorship and engagement reporting
benefit: Measure sponsor performance by asset and clicks on app homepage elements.
detail: A sponsorships dashboard shows views, clicks and click-through rate per sponsor and asset, backed by a new sponsor interactions report. A click and impression report for mobile app homepage elements is available as an admin panel export, and existing dashboard graphs were refined.

title: Unified global search
benefit: Search everything from one field with live suggestions and a single results page that groups people, sessions and content.
detail: The search field suggests queries as you type and opens a unified results page with top results, quick links, 'Show all' views, saved queries and a way back to results from any detail page. Organisers control which blocks appear, their labels and order, and search terms in links filter news, participants and sessions.

title: More content in AI search
benefit: Find pavilions, community groups and on-demand sessions through AI search.
detail: Pavilions are indexed with their grouped exhibitors, community groups can be found by name or topic, and on-demand sessions are searchable by title, speaker or topic.

title: Redesigned admin AI assistant
benefit: Use a redesigned chat interface for the AI assistant in the admin panel.
detail: The admin assistant has a new front end, built as the first version of the interface for the platform's AI assistant.

title: Integrations catalogue
benefit: See every available integration in one catalogue in the admin panel, with its category and status for your event.
detail: A new Integrations page lists hub and existing integrations with descriptions, category tags and whether each is active for the event. SAML 2.0 settings now have their own page in the catalogue.

title: API sponsor analytics and session filters
benefit: Read sponsor interaction analytics and set custom session filters through the public API.
detail: A new endpoint returns sponsor views, clicks, favourites, meetings and messages, and session endpoints can set and return up to five custom filters.

title: More reliable integration syncing
benefit: Keep partner data in step with self-healing sync, sync history and email-first matching.
detail: ExpoFP and Visit now run on the hub's automatic update engine, with removed exhibitors recreated, sync history and logs, and a configurable polling interval. An 'Email First' matching option keeps attendee profiles together when their email changes upstream.

title: Product management in Public API v3
benefit: Create, update and delete products across all events through the API, including their images, videos and media.
detail: New v3 endpoints create global products, update global fields, delete a product from every event in one call, and upload or remove images, videos and media files, keeping image order and the main image.

title: Swoogo integration
benefit: Sync registrants, speakers and exhibitors from Swoogo automatically, including cancellations.
detail: The inbound integration runs on the integration hub, matches records by external ID, groups exhibitors by company and keeps team members linked.

title: Faster web pages
benefit: Load web pages and images faster with less data transferred.
detail: The portal requests resized WebP images instead of originals, the web app manifest is cached instead of refetched on every navigation, and frontend bundles and builds were optimised.

title: Private favourites for opted-out users
benefit: Let attendees who opt out of networking favourite exhibitors, people and products privately.
detail: Opted-out users can favourite and unfavourite exhibitors, visitors, speakers and products on web and in the app, with the action kept private so they are not exposed as leads.

title: Redesigned admin panel pages
benefit: Work in a cleaner, modern admin panel on the most used pages, with nothing to relearn.
detail: Event setup, categories setup, event list, exhibitor list, participants list and sessions list pages were restyled to a new design with no change to how they work.

title: Selective event cloning
benefit: Choose exactly which content carries over when you clone an event.
detail: The clone dialog offers separate checkboxes for sponsors, news, sessions, local categories and other content categories.

title: Separate sign-in settings by profile
benefit: Configure one-time password sign-in separately for company and individual profiles.
detail: Organisers set one-time password authentication independently for company and individual profiles per event, and admin accounts gain a phone field.

title: Trusted embed domains
benefit: Embed authenticated content such as on-demand sessions on approved partner sites.
detail: A security settings section lets organisers whitelist trusted external domains so authenticated content plays when embedded there.
